śilāṃ candanajāṃ vāpi devadārubhavāmathā.
śiṃśapākṣoṭasaralakadambārjunajāmathā. ..13..
1.61.d:
शिलां चन्दनजां वापि देवदारुभवामथा।
शिंशपाक्षोटसरलकदम्बार्जुनजामथा॥.13॥
1.61.m: or stone, or made of sandalwood, or made of deodar, / or made of śiṃśapā, walnut, sarala, kadamba, or arjuna;

1.61.s:
sālvāśvakarṇajāṃ rāma tvāyāmena tathaiva ca ..
vāmapravāṇāṃ prakṣālya pūrṇakumbhānnavāṃstataḥ..14..
1.61.d:
साल्वाश्वकर्णजां राम त्वायामेन तथैव च ॥
वामप्रवाणां प्रक्षाल्य पूर्णकुम्भान्नवांस्ततः॥14॥
1.61.m: or made of sāl or aśvakarṇa, O Rāma, in the same dimension; / having washed [it] sloping to the left, [he should place] fresh full water-pots.

1.61.s:
kalpanīyāstu kalaśāścatvāro bhṛgunandana..
sauvarṇā rājatāstāmrā athavāpi ha rītijāḥ..15..
1.61.d:
कल्पनीयास्तु कलशाश्चत्वारो भृगुनन्दन॥
सौवर्णा राजतास्ताम्रा अथवापि ह रीतिजाः॥15॥
1.61.m: Four jars are to be prepared, O son of Bhṛgu: / made of gold, silver, copper, or indeed of brass.

1.61.s:
pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca tvarghyaṃ snānīyameva ca ..
pādyātpādyaṃ tu dātavyaṃ snānīyātsnānameva ca..16..
1.61.d:
पाद्यमाचमनीयं च त्वर्घ्यं स्नानीयमेव च ॥
पाद्यात्पाद्यं तु दातव्यं स्नानीयात्स्नानमेव च॥16॥
1.61.m: Water for the feet, water for sipping, water of honour, and bath water: / water for the feet is to be given from the foot-vessel, and the bath itself from the bath-vessel;

1.61.s:
tathāpyācamanīyākhyāddeyamācamanaṃ bhavet ..
dānaṃ praṇayanaṃ prītirvisargaṃ vistaraṃ tathā ..17..
1.61.d:
तथाप्याचमनीयाख्याद्देयमाचमनं भवेत् ॥
दानं प्रणयनं प्रीतिर्विसर्गं विस्तरं तथा ॥17॥
1.61.m: likewise water for sipping must be given from that named the sipping-vessel. / Giving, bringing near, delight, dismissal, and spreading out,

1.61.s:
tarpaṇaṃ cārhaṇaṃ caiva tvarghyādetāni kārayet ..
dvādaśākṣarakaṃ mantraṃ tato japtvā samāhitaḥ .. 18 ..
1.61.d:
तर्पणं चार्हणं चैव त्वर्घ्यादेतानि कारयेत् ॥
द्वादशाक्षरकं मन्त्रं ततो जप्त्वा समाहितः ॥ 18 ॥
1.61.m: satiation and honoring—one should perform these through the water of honour. / Then, having muttered the twelve-syllable mantra with concentrated mind,

1.61.s:
tataḥ pavitramantreṇa vedimabhyukṣayeddvija ..
ātmānaṃ ca tathā bhogānkuryānmārgatrayaṃ tataḥ..19..
1.61.d:
ततः पवित्रमन्त्रेण वेदिमभ्युक्षयेद्द्विज ॥
आत्मानं च तथा भोगान्कुर्यान्मार्गत्रयं ततः॥19॥
1.61.m: the twice-born should then sprinkle the altar with the purifying mantra, / and [sprinkle] himself and the offerings, and then make the three paths:

1.61.s:
vidyā jñānaṃ tataḥ karma brahmacakraṃ tathaiva ca ..
mārgatrayañca kartavyaṃ nāmārghyakalaśānsadā .. 1.61.20 ..
1.61.d:
विद्या ज्ञानं ततः कर्म ब्रह्मचक्रं तथैव च ॥
मार्गत्रयञ्च कर्तव्यं नामार्घ्यकलशान्सदा ॥ 1.61.20 ॥
1.61.m: knowledge (vidyā), gnosis (jñāna), and then action (karma), and likewise the wheel of Brahmā. / And the three paths should always be made: the jars of the water of honour with their names,

1.61.s:
pāṇimārgaṃ kūrcamārgaṃ madhumārgaṃ tathaiva ca ..
uśīramūlajaṃ kūrcaṃ jīva nnopālasambhavam ..21..
1.61.d:
पाणिमार्गं कूर्चमार्गं मधुमार्गं तथैव च ॥
उशीरमूलजं कूर्चं जीव न्नोपालसम्भवम् ॥21॥
1.61.m: the hand-path, the brush-path, and likewise the honey-path. / The brush is made from the root of uśīra, or arising from jīvannopāla;

1.61.s:
jīvaśca maraṇaṃ cāpi kartavyaṃ bhṛgunandana ..
pratisnānaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ samānānāṃ kramādbhavet..22..
1.61.d:
जीवश्च मरणं चापि कर्तव्यं भृगुनन्दन ॥
प्रतिस्नानं ततः कार्यं समानानां क्रमाद्भवेत्॥22॥
1.61.m: living and dying are also to be performed, O son of Bhṛgu. / Then reciprocal bathing is to be done, which should be in sequence for identical [vessels].

1.61.s:
tathaiva pādapīṭhānāṃ prabhāvena mahābhujaḥ ..
āsanānyatha kāryāṇi ratnacitrāṇi bhārgava .. 23 ..
1.61.d:
तथैव पादपीठानां प्रभावेन महाभुजः ॥
आसनान्यथ कार्याणि रत्नचित्राणि भार्गव ॥ 23 ॥
1.61.m: Likewise, by the power of the footstools, O mighty-armed one, / seats should then be made, adorned with varied gems, O Bhārgava,

1.61.s:
sauvarṇānyatha raupyāṇi tāmraśailamayāni ca ..
tatastvāvāhanaṃ kāryaṃ tato'bhi gamanaṃ tataḥ ..24..
1.61.d:
सौवर्णान्यथ रौप्याणि ताम्रशैलमयानि च ॥
ततस्त्वावाहनं कार्यं ततोऽभि गमनं ततः ॥24॥
1.61.m: made of gold, silver, copper, or stone. / Then the invocation is to be made, then the approach, then

1.61.s:
namaskārastataḥ kāryaḥ praṇītena tataḥ punaḥ ..
brahmaśvakrāmanau mantraṃ prabhavenāpi yena ca..29..
1.61.d:
नमस्कारस्ततः कार्यः प्रणीतेन ततः पुनः ॥
ब्रह्मश्वक्रामनौ मन्त्रं प्रभवेनापि येन च॥29॥
1.61.m: the obeisance is then to be performed, with the holy water then again; / by means of the mantra of the wheel of Brahmā and by whatever power [one has],

1.61.s:
tato japtvā mahābhāga praṇavena nivedayet ..
āsanairarcayeddevaṃ tataḥ prayatamānasaḥ .. 26 ...
1.61.d:
ततो जप्त्वा महाभाग प्रणवेन निवेदयेत् ॥
आसनैरर्चयेद्देवं ततः प्रयतमानसः ॥ 26 ॥।
1.61.m: having then muttered [it], O fortunate one, one should offer with the praṇava. / Then, with a restrained mind, one should worship the God with seats;

1.61.s:
arghyābhiradbhiśca tato bhogaiḥ sarvairanantaram ..
pādyapratigraheṇātha pādyābhiścāpyanantaram .. .. 27..
1.61.d:
अर्घ्याभिरद्भिश्च ततो भोगैः सर्वैरनन्तरम् ॥
पाद्यप्रतिग्रहेणाथ पाद्याभिश्चाप्यनन्तरम् ॥ ॥ 27॥
1.61.m: and then with waters of honour, immediately thereafter with all enjoyments, / then with acceptance of foot-water, and immediately with waters for the feet;

1.61.s:
pādukābhistato rāma devadevaṃ samarcayet ..
tatastvācamanīyārthaṃ devadevapratigraham .. 28 ..
1.61.d:
पादुकाभिस्ततो राम देवदेवं समर्चयेत् ॥
ततस्त्वाचमनीयार्थं देवदेवप्रतिग्रहम् ॥ 28 ॥
1.61.m: then with sandals, O Rāma, one should worship the God of gods; / then, for the purpose of sipping water, the acceptance for the God of gods,

1.61.s:
devamācamanīyañca pādapīṭhāṃstathaiva ca ..
dantakāṣṭhaṃ tato dadyājjihvānirlekhanaṃ tataḥ .. 29 ..
1.61.d:
देवमाचमनीयञ्च पादपीठांस्तथैव च ॥
दन्तकाष्ठं ततो दद्याज्जिह्वानिर्लेखनं ततः ॥ 29 ॥
1.61.m: water for sipping for the God, and likewise footstools. / Then one should give a tooth-stick, then a tongue-scraper;

1.61.s:
gaṇḍūṣaṇaṃ tato dadyānmukhaprakṣālanaṃ tathā ..
bhūyastvācamanaṃ deyaṃ tarpaṇaṃ cāpyanntaram .. 1.61.30..
1.61.d:
गण्डूषणं ततो दद्यान्मुखप्रक्षालनं तथा ॥
भूयस्त्वाचमनं देयं तर्पणं चाप्यन्न्तरम् ॥ 1.61.30॥
1.61.m: then one should give water for gargling and washing of the mouth; / once again water for sipping is to be given, and satiation immediately thereafter.

1.61.s:
puṣpaṃ dīpamalaṅkāraṃ dhūpaprakarameva ca .
nivedya vidhivatsarvaṃ tataḥ paścānnivedayet .. 31 ..
1.61.d:
पुष्पं दीपमलङ्कारं धूपप्रकरमेव च ।
निवेद्य विधिवत्सर्वं ततः पश्चान्निवेदयेत् ॥ 31 ॥
1.61.m: Flowers, a lamp, ornaments, and a multitude of incenses, / having offered everything according to rule, one should then offer afterwards:

1.61.s:
sevyāni rāma bījāni tvarhaṇīyaṃ tataḥ punaḥ ..
madhuparkaṃ tato dadyāddadhi sarpistathā madhu .. 32 ...
1.61.d:
सेव्यानि राम बीजानि त्वर्हणीयं ततः पुनः ॥
मधुपर्कं ततो दद्याद्दधि सर्पिस्तथा मधु ॥ 32 ॥।
1.61.m: seeds worthy of use, O Rāma, and then again what is fit for honour; / then one should give honey-mixture: curds, clarified butter, and honey.

1.61.s:
dadhyalābhe payaḥ kāryaṃ madhvalābhe tathā guḍam ..
ghṛtapratinidhirnāsti tatra yatnātsamarcayet .. 33 ..
1.61.d:
दध्यलाभे पयः कार्यं मध्वलाभे तथा गुडम् ॥
घृतप्रतिनिधिर्नास्ति तत्र यत्नात्समर्चयेत् ॥ 33 ॥
1.61.m: If curds are unavailable, milk is to be used; if honey is unavailable, molasses; / there is no substitute for clarified butter, [so] one should worship there with effort.

1.61.s:
ekāṃgo vā samasto vā madhuparko vidhīyate ..
vyaṃgaṃ varjyaṃ prayatnena nityameva vijānatā .. 34 ..
1.61.d:
एकांगो वा समस्तो वा मधुपर्को विधीयते ॥
व्यंगं वर्ज्यं प्रयत्नेन नित्यमेव विजानता ॥ 34 ॥
1.61.m: The honey-mixture is prescribed as having one constituent or all of them; / one that is deficient in constituents should be avoided with effort constantly by one who knows.

1.61.s:
darpaṇaṃ tu tato dadyāttato nirbhartsanaṃ budhaḥ ..
tatastvācamanīyaṃ ca vidhivatsusamāhitaḥ ..39..
1.61.d:
दर्पणं तु ततो दद्यात्ततो निर्भर्त्सनं बुधः ॥
ततस्त्वाचमनीयं च विधिवत्सुसमाहितः ॥39॥
1.61.m: The wise man should then give a mirror, then a threatening [gesture/substance]; / then water for sipping, according to rule, highly concentrated.

1.61.s:
hastaniṣpuṃsanārthāya tato dadyāttu gaṃdhakam ..
tataḥ paśuṃ budhaḥ kuryyādyathāvanmādhupārkikam ..36..
1.61.d:
हस्तनिष्पुंसनार्थाय ततो दद्यात्तु गंधकम् ॥
ततः पशुं बुधः कुर्य्याद्यथावन्माधुपार्किकम् ॥36॥
1.61.m: Then one should give perfume for wiping the hands; / then the wise man should properly make an animal [effigy] fit for the honey-mixture,

1.61.s:
mādhupārkikamaśvatthapatraṃ vā vinivedayet ..
ghṛtāvadyaṃ tato dadyāttāmbūlañcāpyanantaram .. 37 ..
1.61.d:
माधुपार्किकमश्वत्थपत्रं वा विनिवेदयेत् ॥
घृतावद्यं ततो दद्यात्ताम्बूलञ्चाप्यनन्तरम् ॥ 37 ॥
1.61.m: or offer a sacred-fig leaf fit for the honey-mixture. / Then one should give clarified butter [...], and betel immediately thereafter;

1.61.s:
mātrāñca dakṣiṇārthāya brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ..
maṃgalāni yathāśaktyā tato deve nivedayet ..38..
1.61.d:
मात्राञ्च दक्षिणार्थाय ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥
मंगलानि यथाशक्त्या ततो देवे निवेदयेत् ॥38॥
1.61.m: and one should present a measured gift to a brahmin for the sake of the sacrificial fee. / Then one should present auspicious items to the God according to one's capacity.

1.61.s:
tato'bhigamakālantu saṃdadyātpuruṣottame..
upādānamatho dadyātkuryāccaiva visarjanam .. 39 ..
1.61.d:
ततोऽभिगमकालन्तु संदद्यात्पुरुषोत्तमे॥
उपादानमथो दद्यात्कुर्याच्चैव विसर्जनम् ॥ 39 ॥
1.61.m: Then one should join the time of approaching to Puruṣottama; / then one should give the gathering of materials, and perform the dismissal.

1.61.s:
tato'gniśaraṇaṃ gatvā vahniṃ saṃtarpadedbudhaḥ ..
brāhmaṇānāṃ yathāśakti dānaṃ dadyādanantaram .. 1.61.40..
1.61.d:
ततोऽग्निशरणं गत्वा वह्निं संतर्पदेद्बुधः ॥
ब्राह्मणानां यथाशक्ति दानं दद्यादनन्तरम् ॥ 1.61.40॥
1.61.m: Then, having gone to the fire-sanctuary, the wise man should satisfy the fire; / immediately thereafter, he should give gifts to brahmins according to his capacity.

1.61.s: etanmayā te kathitaṃ samagraṃ yathānupūrvyābhigamasya kālam .. gacchedupādānakṛtaprayatnastato yathāvadbhṛguvaṃśacandra .. 41 ..
1.61.d: एतन्मया ते कथितं समग्रं यथानुपूर्व्याभिगमस्य कालम् ॥ गच्छेदुपादानकृतप्रयत्नस्ततो यथावद्भृगुवंशचन्द्र ॥ 41 ॥
1.61.m: This time of approaching has been fully told to you by me in proper order; / one should then proceed having made effort in the gathering of materials, according to rule, O moon of Bhṛgu's lineage.

1.62.s:
.. śaṅkara uvāca ..
bhogānāmarjanaṃ kāryaṃ tato rāma svakarmaṇā ..
sthirāṇāmasthirāṇāṃ ca yathāvadbhṛgunandana .. 1 ..
1.62.d:
॥ शङ्कर उवाच ॥
भोगानामर्जनं कार्यं ततो राम स्वकर्मणा ॥
स्थिराणामस्थिराणां च यथावद्भृगुनन्दन ॥ 1 ॥
1.62.m:
Śaṅkara said:
Then, O Rāma, one must procure offerings by one's own occupation, / both fixed and movable, in accordance with the rule, O delight of the Bhṛgus.

1.62.s:
āsanādyāstu ye bhogāḥ kālenāpyavināśinaḥ ..
sthirāste rāma nirdiṣṭā pariśiṣṭāstathā carāḥ .. 2 ..
1.62.d:
आसनाद्यास्तु ये भोगाः कालेनाप्यविनाशिनः ॥
स्थिरास्ते राम निर्दिष्टा परिशिष्टास्तथा चराः ॥ 2 ॥
1.62.m: Offerings such as seats that do not perish even with time / are declared fixed, O Rāma, and the rest are movable.

1.62.s:
puṣpaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ mūlaṃ tathā haritakaṃ śubham ..
udakaṃ cārcanīyaṃ syāttasminnahani bhārgav .. 3 ..
1.62.d:
पुष्पं पत्रं फलं मूलं तथा हरितकं शुभम् ॥
उदकं चार्चनीयं स्यात्तस्मिन्नहनि भार्गव् ॥ 3 ॥
1.62.m: Flower, leaf, fruit, root, and fresh greens, / and pure water are to be offered on that day, O descendant of Bhṛgu.

1.62.s:
upādānāya niṣkrānte kuṭumbinyatha satvaram ..
kuṭumbinī suprayātā dhautopaskarabhājanā ..4..
1.62.d:
उपादानाय निष्क्रान्ते कुटुम्बिन्यथ सत्वरम् ॥
कुटुम्बिनी सुप्रयाता धौतोपस्करभाजना ॥4॥
1.62.m: When the master of the house has gone out to collect offerings, then swiftly / the mistress of the house, well-disciplined, having washed the utensils and vessels,

1.62.s:
sādhyānāṃ rāma bījānāṃ paśośca sukṛtasya ca ..
śākānāṃ vyañjanānāṃ ca svarjitānāṃ gate'hani ..5..
1.62.d:
साध्यानां राम बीजानां पशोश्च सुकृतस्य च ॥
शाकानां व्यञ्जनानां च स्वर्जितानां गतेऽहनि ॥5॥
1.62.m: of seeds to be cooked, O Rāma, and of animals properly prepared, / and of vegetables and side-dishes procured on the preceding day,

1.62.s:
śaktiṃ kuryātsadā tasya vahninopadamena ca ..
deśe śucau suprayātā susahāyaguṇānvitā .. 6 ..
1.62.d:
शक्तिं कुर्यात्सदा तस्य वह्निनोपदमेन च ॥
देशे शुचौ सुप्रयाता सुसहायगुणान्विता ॥ 6 ॥
1.62.m: should always prepare what she is able with fire and by cooking; / in a clean place, very attentive, accompanied by virtuous helpers,

1.62.s:
sarvaṃ prakṣālitaṃ kāryaṃ keśakīṭādivarjitam ..
bhūmāvanupaliptāyāṃ sthāpyaṃ rāma na kiñcana ..7..
1.62.d:
सर्वं प्रक्षालितं कार्यं केशकीटादिवर्जितम् ॥
भूमावनुपलिप्तायां स्थाप्यं राम न किञ्चन ॥7॥
1.62.m: everything must be washed, free of hairs, insects, and the like; / nothing, O Rāma, should be placed upon ground that has not been smeared.

1.62.s:
sarvaṃ sādhyamathānnādyaṃ gandhavarṇarasānvitam ..
nityaṃ paripacedrāma nāsvādyaṃ kenacit kvacit ..8..
1.62.d:
सर्वं साध्यमथान्नाद्यं गन्धवर्णरसान्वितम् ॥
नित्यं परिपचेद्राम नास्वाद्यं केनचित् क्वचित् ॥8॥
1.62.m: All food to be cooked, endowed with fragrance, color, and taste, / she must thoroughly cook every day, O Rāma; it must never be tasted by anyone.

1.62.s:
upādānamathādāya praviśya ca gṛhī gṛham ..
śucau prakṣālitaṃ sarvaṃ copādānamupanyaset .. 9 ..
1.62.d:
उपादानमथादाय प्रविश्य च गृही गृहम् ॥
शुचौ प्रक्षालितं सर्वं चोपादानमुपन्यसेत् ॥ 9 ॥
1.62.m: Then, having gathered the offerings and entered the house, the householder / should place all the gathered offerings in a clean, washed place.

1.62.s:
suprakṣālya tathā bhāgaṃ pavitreṇa samutkṣipet ..
evaṃ kṛtvā hyupādānaṃ snāyāttu vidhinā tataḥ .. 1.62.10 ..
1.62.d:
सुप्रक्षाल्य तथा भागं पवित्रेण समुत्क्षिपेत् ॥
एवं कृत्वा ह्युपादानं स्नायात्तु विधिना ततः ॥ 1.62.10 ॥
1.62.m: Having washed the portion well, he should lift it up with a strainer; / having thus made the gathering of offerings, he should then bathe according to the rules.

1.62.s:
dhautavāsā suprayataḥ svācāntaḥ susamāhitaḥ ..
praviśya devatāveśma prāgvadbhṛgukulodvaha .. 11 ..
1.62.d:
धौतवासा सुप्रयतः स्वाचान्तः सुसमाहितः ॥
प्रविश्य देवतावेश्म प्राग्वद्भृगुकुलोद्वह ॥ 11 ॥
1.62.m: Wearing clean garments, very pure, having properly sipped water, fully concentrated, / having entered the temple of the deity as before, O upholder of the Bhṛgu race,

1.62.s:
namaskārādikaṃ sarvaṃ prayuñjīta samāhitaḥ ..
upādānānusaṃdhānaṃ tvādānaṃ cāpyanantaram .. 12 ..
1.62.d:
नमस्कारादिकं सर्वं प्रयुञ्जीत समाहितः ॥
उपादानानुसंधानं त्वादानं चाप्यनन्तरम् ॥ 12 ॥
1.62.m: he should perform all rites such as prostrations with a concentrated mind, / and immediately thereafter the examination and taking up of the gathered offerings.
O knower of dharma, with a purified mind, he should observe the time of worship.

1.62.s:
āsannabhogaḥ prayanāntarātmā kuryādathejyāṃ raṇacaṇḍavega ..
krodhaṃ niyamyātmahite niviṣṭastadbhāvabhāvopahitaśca nityam .. 14 ..
1.62.d:
आसन्नभोगः प्रयनान्तरात्मा कुर्यादथेज्यां रणचण्डवेग ॥
क्रोधं नियम्यात्महिते निविष्टस्तद्भावभावोपहितश्च नित्यम् ॥ 14 ॥
1.62.m: Having the offerings ready, restrained in his inner self, he should then perform worship, O you of fierce speed in battle, / restraining anger, intent on his own welfare, and constantly absorbed in devotion to Him.

1.62.s: iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 śaṅkaragītāsūpādānakaraṇo nāma dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāya ..62..
1.62.d: इति श्रीविष्णुधर्मोत्तरे प्रथमखण्डे मा0सं0 शङ्करगीतासूपादानकरणो नाम द्विषष्टितमोऽध्याय ॥62॥
1.62.m: Thus ends the sixty-second chapter, entitled "The Gathering of Offerings," in the Śaṅkaragītā within the dialogue between Mārkaṇḍeya and Vajra, in the first book of the holy Viṣṇudharmottara.

1.63.s:
.. śaṅkara uvāca ..
pādapīṭhāntakaṃ karma kṛtvā prāguktamañjasā ..
nivedya darpaṇaṃ deve tato mātrāṃ nivedayeta .. 1 ..
1.63.d:
॥ शङ्कर उवाच ॥
पादपीठान्तकं कर्म कृत्वा प्रागुक्तमञ्जसा ॥
निवेद्य दर्पणं देवे ततो मात्रां निवेदयेत ॥ 1 ॥
1.63.m:
Śaṅkara said:
Having properly performed the rite up to the footstool as previously stated, / and having presented a mirror to the God, he should then offer a measuring portion.

1.63.s:
bījaistu paridhānārthaṃ prayataḥ susamāhita ..
tailamudvartanaṃ caiva camasīṃ cāpyanantaram .. 2 ..
1.63.d:
बीजैस्तु परिधानार्थं प्रयतः सुसमाहित ॥
तैलमुद्वर्तनं चैव चमसीं चाप्यनन्तरम् ॥ 2 ॥
1.63.m: Pure and fully concentrated, [he offers] grains for the sake of clothing, / and immediately thereafter oil, anointing paste, and an ointment spoon.

1.63.s:
tato niṣpuṃsanaṃ kṛtvā deyānyācamanāni ca ..
ropraṃ kālīyakaṃ caiva tathā vai bījapūrakam .. 3 ..
1.63.d:
ततो निष्पुंसनं कृत्वा देयान्याचमनानि च ॥
रोप्रं कालीयकं चैव तथा वै बीजपूरकम् ॥ 3 ॥
1.63.m: Then, having wiped [the image] dry, sips of water should be offered; / and ropra, kālīyaka, and citron,

1.63.s:
varṇakaṃ tagaraṃ caiva priyaṅguṃ gaurasarṣapāḥ ..
sarvauṣadhīrvṛkṣabījaṃ sarvagandhāṃśca bhārgava..4..
1.63.d:
वर्णकं तगरं चैव प्रियङ्गुं गौरसर्षपाः ॥
सर्वौषधीर्वृक्षबीजं सर्वगन्धांश्च भार्गव॥4॥
1.63.m: coloring paste, tagara, priyaṅgu, white mustard seeds, / all medicinal herbs, tree seeds, and all fragrant substances, O descendant of Bhṛgu,

1.63.s:
ratnodakaṃ ca vividhaṃ snānīyamudakaṃ tathā ..
snānīyaṃ ca tato rāma susugandhaṃ ca dāpayet..5..
1.63.d:
रत्नोदकं च विविधं स्नानीयमुदकं तथा ॥
स्नानीयं च ततो राम सुसुगन्धं च दापयेत्॥5॥
1.63.m: and diverse gem-infused waters and bathing water; / then, O Rāma, he should offer fragrant bath-powder.

1.63.s:
tataḥ sugharmaṇārthīyāḥ kalaśā sumanoharā ..
svalaṃkṛtā pradātavyā phalapallavapūritāḥ..6..
1.63.d:
ततः सुघर्मणार्थीयाः कलशा सुमनोहरा ॥
स्वलंकृता प्रदातव्या फलपल्लवपूरिताः॥6॥
1.63.m: Then charming pitchers for cooling water / should be offered, well-decorated and filled with fruits and sprouts,

1.63.s:
puṣpagandhayutā rāma pavitreṇa pavitritāḥ ..
śubhānāṃ tīrthasaritāṃ rāma puṇyajalaiḥ śubhaiḥ.. ..7..
1.63.d:
पुष्पगन्धयुता राम पवित्रेण पवित्रिताः ॥
शुभानां तीर्थसरितां राम पुण्यजलैः शुभैः॥ ॥7॥
1.63.m: supplied with flowers and scents, O Rāma, purified with a strainer, / [filled] with the auspicious holy waters of sacred rivers, O Rāma.

1.63.s:
yathāvibhavatasteṣāṃ bahutvamapi kārayet ..
tasminkāle tathā kārye kṣveḍitotkṛṣṭaniḥsvanam ..8..
1.63.d:
यथाविभवतस्तेषां बहुत्वमपि कारयेत् ॥
तस्मिन्काले तथा कार्ये क्ष्वेडितोत्कृष्टनिःस्वनम् ॥8॥
1.63.m: According to his means, he may also provide many of them; / at that time and in that rite, loud cheers and shouting,

1.63.s:
jayaśabdaṃ ca vipulaṃ śaṅkhabherīvimiśritam..
udakagrahaṇārthīya tato dadyācca śāṭakam .. 9 ..
1.63.d:
जयशब्दं च विपुलं शङ्खभेरीविमिश्रितम्॥
उदकग्रहणार्थीय ततो दद्याच्च शाटकम् ॥ 9 ॥
1.63.m: and great cries of victory mixed with the sound of conches and kettledrums [should be made]; / then he should present a cloth for absorbing the water.

1.63.s:
tato rāma pradātavyaṃ dhautavāsāyugaṃ śubham ..
tatastu pūrṇakalaśamāsanānāṃ pradakṣiṇam ..1.63.1 0..
1.63.d:
ततो राम प्रदातव्यं धौतवासायुगं शुभम् ॥
ततस्तु पूर्णकलशमासनानां प्रदक्षिणम् ॥1.63.1 0॥
1.63.m: Then, O Rāma, a pair of auspicious clean garments must be given; / then, having carried a full pitcher circumambulating the seats from left to right,

1.63.s:
kṛtvā rāma kṣipedvedyāṃ puṣpapallavaśobhitam..
tatastvācamanīyaṃ ca pūrvavadvinivedayet..11..
1.63.d:
कृत्वा राम क्षिपेद्वेद्यां पुष्पपल्लवशोभितम्॥
ततस्त्वाचमनीयं च पूर्ववद्विनिवेदयेत्॥11॥
1.63.m: adorned with flowers and sprouts, O Rāma, he should place it upon the altar; / then he should offer water for sipping as before.

1.63.s:
maṅgalāni ca mukhyāni tato dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ ..
satyāsanasthaṃ deveśamarcayiṣyāmyataḥ param .. 12 ..
1.63.d:
मङ्गलानि च मुख्यानि ततो दद्याद्विचक्षणः ॥
सत्यासनस्थं देवेशमर्चयिष्याम्यतः परम् ॥ 12 ॥
1.63.m: Then the wise man should offer the principal auspicious items: / "Henceforth I will worship the Lord of the gods seated on the true seat;

1.63.s:
snānāsanāni tyajyantāmityevaṃ parikīrtayet ..
mārgatrayādathārabhya pādapīṭhāntakaṃ punaḥ .. 13 ..
1.63.d:
स्नानासनानि त्यज्यन्तामित्येवं परिकीर्तयेत् ॥
मार्गत्रयादथारभ्य पादपीठान्तकं पुनः ॥ 13 ॥
1.63.m: let the bathing seats be removed"—thus he should proclaim; / then, beginning from the three paths up to the footstool again,

1.63.s:
kartavyaṃ sakalaṃ karma tvāvāhanavisarjanam ..
tato'nulepanaṃ dadyādvyajanena ca vījayet .. 14 ..
1.63.d:
कर्तव्यं सकलं कर्म त्वावाहनविसर्जनम् ॥
ततोऽनुलेपनं दद्याद्व्यजनेन च वीजयेत् ॥ 14 ॥
1.63.m: the entire rite, with invocation and dismissal, should be performed; / then he should apply unguent and fan Him with a fan.

1.63.s:
tataśca vīṭakaṃ dadyāttathā kūrcaprasādanam ..
vastraṃ vibhūṣaṇaṃ caiva puṣpāṇi vividhāni ca .. 15 ..
1.63.d:
ततश्च वीटकं दद्यात्तथा कूर्चप्रसादनम् ॥
वस्त्रं विभूषणं चैव पुष्पाणि विविधानि च ॥ 15 ॥
1.63.m: Then he should offer betel, and a comb for the beard, / garments, ornaments, and various kinds of flowers,

1.63.s:
veṣṭanaṃ ca srajaṃ caiva kaṅkaṇaṃ ca manoharam ..
tathā ramyaṃ pratisaraṃ supiṣṭaṃ ca tathāñjanam .. 16 ..
1.63.d:
वेष्टनं च स्रजं चैव कङ्कणं च मनोहरम् ॥
तथा रम्यं प्रतिसरं सुपिष्टं च तथाञ्जनम् ॥ 16 ॥
1.63.m: a turban, a garland, and a charming bracelet, / and an attractive protective amulet-thread, and finely ground collyrium,

1.63.s:
darpaṇaṃ copacāraṃ ca pradīpaṃ dhūpameva ca ..
tathaivācamanīyaṃ ca gītavādyasvaraṃ tathā .. 17..
1.63.d:
दर्पणं चोपचारं च प्रदीपं धूपमेव च ॥
तथैवाचमनीयं च गीतवाद्यस्वरं तथा ॥ 17॥
1.63.m: a mirror, respectful service, a lamp, and incense, / and likewise water for sipping, and the sound of vocal and instrumental music,

1.63.s:
puṇyāhajayaśabdaṃ ca stotrodīraṇameva ca ..
tathaivopānahau deye chatraṃ cāmarameva ca .. 18 ..
1.63.d:
पुण्याहजयशब्दं च स्तोत्रोदीरणमेव च ॥
तथैवोपानहौ देये छत्रं चामरमेव च ॥ 18 ॥
1.63.m: declarations of an auspicious day, cries of victory, and the recitation of hymns; / likewise two sandals should be given, an umbrella, and a flywhisk,

1.63.s:
yānaṃ ca vāhanaṃ caiva patākāśca dhvajāni ca ..
bhogānāṃ pūraṇārthīyāṃ tato mātrāṃ nivedayet .. 19 ..
1.63.d:
यानं च वाहनं चैव पताकाश्च ध्वजानि च ॥
भोगानां पूरणार्थीयां ततो मात्रां निवेदयेत् ॥ 19 ॥
1.63.m: a carriage, a mount, banners, and flags; / then he should present a measuring portion to supply all offerings.

1.63.s:
bhogānāṃ sarjanaṃ kṛtvā yathāśaktayā dvijottama ..
avidyamānā ye bhogā mātrāsveva prakalpayet .. 1.63.20 ..
1.63.d:
भोगानां सर्जनं कृत्वा यथाशक्तया द्विजोत्तम ॥
अविद्यमाना ये भोगा मात्रास्वेव प्रकल्पयेत् ॥ 1.63.20 ॥
1.63.m: Having produced offerings according to his ability, O best of the twice-born, / whatever offerings are not available he should mentally project into the measuring portions.

1.63.s:
evamabhyarcya deveśaṃ sarvabhogaissamāhitaḥ ..
arcayenmadhuparkeṇa paśuyāgo na cedbhavet .. 21 ..
1.63.d:
एवमभ्यर्च्य देवेशं सर्वभोगैस्समाहितः ॥
अर्चयेन्मधुपर्केण पशुयागो न चेद्भवेत् ॥ 21 ॥
1.63.m: Having thus worshipped the Lord of the gods with all offerings, concentrated, / he should worship Him with honey-mixture if there is no animal sacrifice.

1.63.s:
paśuyāgābhigamane madhuparko vidhīyate ..
abhyarcya madhuparkeṇa tatastvanyena pūjayet .. 22 ..|
1.63.d:
पशुयागाभिगमने मधुपर्को विधीयते ॥
अभ्यर्च्य मधुपर्केण ततस्त्वन्येन पूजयेत् ॥ 22 ॥।
1.63.m: If approaching with an animal sacrifice, the honey-mixture is prescribed; / having worshipped with the honey-mixture, he should then worship with other things.

1.63.s:
atrāsanānyapīcchanti kecidapyaparāṇi tu ..
ādau sthālīṃ ca tenātha pradadyādarhaṇīṃ tataḥ .. 23..
1.63.d:
अत्रासनान्यपीच्छन्ति केचिदप्यपराणि तु ॥
आदौ स्थालीं च तेनाथ प्रदद्यादर्हणीं ततः ॥ 23॥
1.63.m: Here, some desire other seats as well; / first the vessel, and with that he should then present the offering of hospitality.

1.63.s:
annaṃ haritakopetaṃ bhakṣyaṃ vyañjanasaṃyutam ..
nivedya darpaṇaṃ dadyāttathā niṣpuṃsanaṃ tataḥ .. 24 ..
1.63.d:
अन्नं हरितकोपेतं भक्ष्यं व्यञ्जनसंयुतम् ॥
निवेद्य दर्पणं दद्यात्तथा निष्पुंसनं ततः ॥ 24 ॥
1.63.m: Food accompanied by fresh greens, edible delicacies along with side-dishes; / having offered them, he should present a mirror and then a wiping cloth;

1.63.s:
kṛtvā hyācamanīyaṃ tu mātrāṃ ca tadanantaram ..
tatastu saṃvibhāgārthaṃ dātavyaṃ tvarhaṇaṃ tataḥ 9..
1.63.d:
कृत्वा ह्याचमनीयं तु मात्रां च तदनन्तरम् ॥
ततस्तु संविभागार्थं दातव्यं त्वर्हणं ततः 9॥
1.63.m: having then provided water for sipping, and immediately thereafter a measuring portion; / then, for the sake of distribution, the offering of hospitality should be presented.

1.63.s:
bhūyo nivedayedannaṃ pūrvavatsusamāhitaḥ ..
darpaṇaṃ ca tato dadyātpādyaṃ niṣpuṃsanaṃ tataḥ .. 26 ...
1.63.d:
भूयो निवेदयेदन्नं पूर्ववत्सुसमाहितः ॥
दर्पणं च ततो दद्यात्पाद्यं निष्पुंसनं ततः ॥ 26 ॥।
1.63.m: He should again offer food as before, well-concentrated; / then he should present a mirror, water for washing the feet, and then a wiping cloth.

1.63.s:
dattvā cācamanīyaṃ ca śāṭakaṃ ca nivedayet ..
hastaniṣpuṃsanārthāya mātrāṃ ca tadanantaram .. 27..
1.63.d:
दत्त्वा चाचमनीयं च शाटकं च निवेदयेत् ॥
हस्तनिष्पुंसनार्थाय मात्रां च तदनन्तरम् ॥ 27॥
1.63.m: Having given water for sipping, he should present a cloth / for the sake of wiping the hands, and immediately thereafter a measuring portion.

1.63.s:
nivedya paścāttāmbūlaṃ devaṃ vahnau samarcayet ..
vahnisaṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā kāryakārisamarpaṇam .. 28 ..
1.63.d:
निवेद्य पश्चात्ताम्बूलं देवं वह्नौ समर्चयेत् ॥
वह्निसंपूजनं कृत्वा कार्यकारिसमर्पणम् ॥ 28 ॥
1.63.m: Having presented betel afterwards, he should worship the God in the fire; / having performed the worship in the fire, he should present [the food] to the servants.

1.63.s:
atithīnāṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ bhartavyānāṃ ca bhārgava ..
tato'nuyāgakāle tu pavitreṇa samutkṣipet .. 29 ..
1.63.d:
अतिथीनां ततः कार्यं भर्तव्यानां च भार्गव ॥
ततोऽनुयागकाले तु पवित्रेण समुत्क्षिपेत् ॥ 29 ॥
1.63.m: Then, O descendant of Bhṛgu, [the feeding] of guests and dependents must be performed; / then, at the time of the follow-up sacrifice, he should lift it up with a strainer.

1.63.s:
āsanaṃ bhājanaṃ caiva sānnaṃ prayatamānasaḥ ..
upaviśya tataḥ paścātprabhavenāpyayena ca .. 1.63.30 ..
1.63.d:
आसनं भाजनं चैव सान्नं प्रयतमानसः ॥
उपविश्य ततः पश्चात्प्रभवेनाप्ययेन च ॥ 1.63.30 ॥
1.63.m: With an attentive mind, [he should offer] a seat and a vessel with food. / Then, having sat down, through [the contemplation of] emergence and dissolution,

1.63.s:
idamagnetimantreṇa prācyāṃ grāsāṣṭakaṃ bhavet ..
tatastu prayato bhūtvā viśeddevagṛhaṃ tataḥ .. 31 ..
1.63.d:
इदमग्नेतिमन्त्रेण प्राच्यां ग्रासाष्टकं भवेत् ॥
ततस्तु प्रयतो भूत्वा विशेद्देवगृहं ततः ॥ 31 ॥
1.63.m: with the mantra beginning 'idam agne', eight mouthfuls should be offered toward the east. / Thereupon, having become purified, he should then enter the house of the deity.

1.63.s:
ijyākālānusaṃdhānaṃ tataḥ kuryātsamāhitaḥ ..
kuryātsvanyāyakālasya copādānamanantaram .. 32 ..
1.63.d:
इज्याकालानुसंधानं ततः कुर्यात्समाहितः ॥
कुर्यात्स्वन्यायकालस्य चोपादानमनन्तरम् ॥ 32 ॥
1.63.m: Then, collected in mind, he should undertake the contemplation for the time of worship (ijyākāla). / Immediately afterwards he should undertake his own appropriate period [of practice].

1.63.s:
visarjanaṃ tataḥ kuryātprayatenāntarātmanā ..
ijyākālavidhistveṣa mayā te rāma kīrtitaḥ .. 33..
1.63.d:
विसर्जनं ततः कुर्यात्प्रयतेनान्तरात्मना ॥
इज्याकालविधिस्त्वेष मया ते राम कीर्तितः ॥ 33॥
1.63.m: Then, with a restrained inner self, he should perform the dismissal. / Thus, O Rāma, has the rule for the time of worship been proclaimed to you by me.

1.63.s:
bhagavānvāsudevastu devassaṃkarṣaṇastataḥ ..
pradyumnaścāniruddhaśca prabhāvo'yamudāhṛtaḥ ..34 ..
1.63.d:
भगवान्वासुदेवस्तु देवस्संकर्षणस्ततः ॥
प्रद्युम्नश्चानिरुद्धश्च प्रभावोऽयमुदाहृतः ॥34 ॥
1.63.m: The Lord is Vāsudeva, and next the god Saṃkarṣaṇa, / Pradyumna, and Aniruddha; this manifestation has been declared.

1.63.s:
saṃkarṣaṇastathāvyakta ātmā pradyumna ucyate ..
devastattvagatassarvaṃ aniruddho mahāyaśāḥ .. 35 ..
1.63.d:
संकर्षणस्तथाव्यक्त आत्मा प्रद्युम्न उच्यते ॥
देवस्तत्त्वगतस्सर्वं अनिरुद्धो महायशाः ॥ 35 ॥
1.63.m: Saṃkarṣaṇa is unmanifest, and the self is called Pradyumna; / the deity Aniruddha, endowed with great renown, pervades all principles.

1.63.s:
sa nāthassarvalokānāṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ..
(puruṣo'pi tathā satya acyutaśca dvijottama .. 36..
1.63.d:
स नाथस्सर्वलोकानां सृष्टिसंहारकारकः॥
(पुरुषोऽपि तथा सत्य अच्युतश्च द्विजोत्तम ॥ 36॥
1.63.m: He is the lord of all worlds, the cause of creation and destruction. / (Likewise, the Cosmic Person, Satya, and Acyuta, O best of the twice-born,

1.63.s:
bhagavānvāsudevaśca tvavyayo'yamudāhṛtaḥ ..
catvāra ete dharmajña vāsudevāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ..37..
1.63.d:
भगवान्वासुदेवश्च त्वव्ययोऽयमुदाहृतः ॥
चत्वार एते धर्मज्ञ वासुदेवाः प्रकीर्तिताः ॥37॥
1.63.m: and the Lord Vāsudeva—this imperishable one is declared. / These four, O knower of dharma, are proclaimed as Vāsudevas,

1.63.s:
bhagavacchabdavācyāśca sarvabhūtabhavodbhavāḥ ..
yaḥ paraḥ puruṣo rāma vāsudevaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 38 ..
1.63.d:
भगवच्छब्दवाच्याश्च सर्वभूतभवोद्भवाः ॥
यः परः पुरुषो राम वासुदेवः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 38 ॥
1.63.m: denoted by the word 'Lord', the source of the coming into being of all beings. / The supreme Cosmic Person who has been proclaimed as Vāsudeva, O Rāma,

1.63.s:
bhagavacchabdavācyaśca sarvabhūtabhavodbhavaḥ ..
śeṣatattvaṃ gataḥ sarvamaniruddho mahāyaśāḥ .. 39 ...
1.63.d:
भगवच्छब्दवाच्यश्च सर्वभूतभवोद्भवः ॥
शेषतत्त्वं गतः सर्वमनिरुद्धो महायशाः ॥ 39 ॥।
1.63.m: denoted by the word 'Lord', the source of the coming into being of all beings, / the illustrious Aniruddha, has pervaded all the ultimate reality of Śeṣa.

1.63.s:
sa nāthaḥ sarvalokānāṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāraṇaḥ .. )
tadetatpaṭhyate sūkte pauruṣe dvijasattama .. 1.63.40 ..
1.63.d:
स नाथः सर्वलोकानां सृष्टिसंहारकारणः ॥ )
तदेतत्पठ्यते सूक्ते पौरुषे द्विजसत्तम ॥ 1.63.40 ॥
1.63.m: He is the lord of all worlds, the cause of creation and destruction.) / This very thing is recited in the Hymn to the Cosmic Person (Puruṣasūkta), O best of the twice-born:

1.63.s:
pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi ..
bhujiḥ prītistathaivārciḥ prāṇastarpaṇamarhaṇam .. 41 ..
1.63.d:
पादोऽस्य विश्वा भूतानि त्रिपादस्यामृतं दिवि ॥
भुजिः प्रीतिस्तथैवार्चिः प्राणस्तर्पणमर्हणम् ॥ 41 ॥
1.63.m: 'A quarter of him is all beings; three-quarters of him are the immortal in heaven.' / Eating, affection, and likewise radiance, breath, satisfying, worship,

1.63.s:
nivedanañcācamanamaṣṭadhā mantranirṇayaḥ ..
mantreṇa cārhaṇāntena pradadyādarhaṇaṃ punaḥ .. 42 ..
1.63.d:
निवेदनञ्चाचमनमष्टधा मन्त्रनिर्णयः ॥
मन्त्रेण चार्हणान्तेन प्रदद्यादर्हणं पुनः ॥ 42 ॥
1.63.m: presentation of offerings, and sipping of water—eightfold is the determination of mantras. / With the mantra ending in 'arhaṇa' he should once again present the offering of honor;

1.63.s:
tathaivācamanāntena deyamācamanaṃ bhavet ..
prāśanāntena mantreṇa tarpaṇaṃ vinivedayet .. 43 ..
1.63.d:
तथैवाचमनान्तेन देयमाचमनं भवेत् ॥
प्राशनान्तेन मन्त्रेण तर्पणं विनिवेदयेत् ॥ 43 ॥
1.63.m: likewise with the one ending in 'ācamana', water for sipping is to be given. / With the mantra ending in 'prāśana' he should offer satisfying water.

1.63.s:
pratigraheṣu mātrāsu pādukāsu ca darpaṇe ..
chatre ca vālavyajane tālavṛnte tathaiva ca .. 44 ..
1.63.d:
प्रतिग्रहेषु मात्रासु पादुकासु च दर्पणे ॥
छत्रे च वालव्यजने तालवृन्ते तथैव च ॥ 44 ॥
1.63.m: In spittoons, measuring vessels, wooden sandals, and mirrors, / in umbrellas, yak-tail whisks, and palm fans as well,

1.63.s:
upānatsu tathā yāne vāhaneṣu bhṛgūttama ..
abdhidhvajeṣu ca tathā patākāsu ca kīrtitāḥ ..45..
1.63.d:
उपानत्सु तथा याने वाहनेषु भृगूत्तम ॥
अब्धिध्वजेषु च तथा पताकासु च कीर्तिताः ॥45॥
1.63.m: in leather shoes, likewise in litters and vehicles, O foremost of the Bhṛgus, / and so also in ocean-standard banners and flags, they are proclaimed.

1.63.s:
śeṣāṇāṃ kāmabhogānāṃ nityaṃ saṃkīrtayettu vai ..
sarvatraprīṇanaṃ kāryametāvānmantranirṇayaḥ ..46..
1.63.d:
शेषाणां कामभोगानां नित्यं संकीर्तयेत्तु वै ॥
सर्वत्रप्रीणनं कार्यमेतावान्मन्त्रनिर्णयः ॥46॥
1.63.m: He should constantly recite [the mantras] of the remaining objects of sensory pleasure; / pleasing is to be performed everywhere; so great is the determination of mantras.

1.63.s:
devānāṃ pādapīṭhānāṃ kalaśānāṃ tathaiva ca ..
vahnestathāsanānāṃ ca catuṣṭvaṃ vinivartate .. 47 ..
1.63.d:
देवानां पादपीठानां कलशानां तथैव च ॥
वह्नेस्तथासनानां च चतुष्ट्वं विनिवर्तते ॥ 47 ॥
1.63.m: Of deities, footstools, and water-jars as well, / and of fire, and seats, the group of four ceases.

1.63.s:
kalaśāsanavahnīnāṃ saṃkaraṃ tu na kārayet ..
tathaiva padapīṭhānāṃ teṣāṃ cihnaṃ ca kārayet .. 48 ..
1.63.d:
कलशासनवह्नीनां संकरं तु न कारयेत् ॥
तथैव पदपीठानां तेषां चिह्नं च कारयेत् ॥ 48 ॥
1.63.m: One should not cause an intermixture of water-jars, seats, and fires, / nor likewise of footstools; one should make an identifying mark for them.

1.63.s:
prāpaṇe madhuparke ca mātrāsu ca bhṛgūttama ..
sumanastu sadā rāma yatnaḥ kāryaḥ samarcane .. 49 ..
1.63.d:
प्रापणे मधुपर्के च मात्रासु च भृगूत्तम ॥
सुमनस्तु सदा राम यत्नः कार्यः समर्चने ॥ 49 ॥
1.63.m: In fetching, in the honey-mixture, and in measuring vessels, O foremost of the Bhṛgus, / an effort should always be made with flowers (sumanas) during worship, O Rāma.

1.63.s:
saumanasyaṃ paraṃ rāma devadeve niveditam ..
yasmāttu vartate tasmātproktāḥ sumanasaḥ sadā .. 1.63.50 ..
1.63.d:
सौमनस्यं परं राम देवदेवे निवेदितम् ॥
यस्मात्तु वर्तते तस्मात्प्रोक्ताः सुमनसः सदा ॥ 1.63.50 ॥
1.63.m: Because supreme well-mindedness (saumanasya) offered to the God of gods / is present, therefore they are always called flowers (sumanas).

1.63.s:
māṃ trāsyati bhayādghorāttasmānmātrā prakīrtitā ..
prāpayiṣyati ca sthāne nityaṃ duḥkhavivarjite .. 51 ..
1.63.d:
मां त्रास्यति भयाद्घोरात्तस्मान्मात्रा प्रकीर्तिता ॥
प्रापयिष्यति च स्थाने नित्यं दुःखविवर्जिते ॥ 51 ॥
1.63.m: 'It will protect me from terrible fear'—therefore it is proclaimed as a measuring vessel (mātrā); / and 'it will cause [one] to reach a state perpetually devoid of sorrow,'

1.63.s:
yasmāttasmāddvijaśreṣṭha proktaṃ prāpaṇakaṃ sadā ..
paramaṃ yatparaṃ rāma madhusaṃjñaṃ taducyate .. 52 ..
1.63.d:
यस्मात्तस्माद्द्विजश्रेष्ठ प्रोक्तं प्रापणकं सदा ॥
परमं यत्परं राम मधुसंज्ञं तदुच्यते ॥ 52 ॥
1.63.m: for which reason, O best of the twice-born, it is always called fetching (prāpaṇaka). / That which is highest and supreme, O Rāma, is called honey (madhu);

1.63.s:
tadāpyate yadā tena madhuparkastadā smṛtaḥ ..
ijyāvidhāno'yamudīritaste samāsato bhārgavavaṃśacandra ..
ataḥ paraṃ rāma nibodha puṇyaṃ svādhyāyakāle gadato mamādya .. 53 ..
1.63.d:
तदाप्यते यदा तेन मधुपर्कस्तदा स्मृतः ॥
इज्याविधानोऽयमुदीरितस्ते समासतो भार्गववंशचन्द्र ॥
अतः परं राम निबोध पुण्यं स्वाध्यायकाले गदतो ममाद्य ॥ 53 ॥
1.63.m: since it is obtained by that, it is therefore remembered as the honey-mixture (madhuparka). / This procedure for worship has been declared to you in brief, O moon of the Bhṛgu lineage; / hereafter, understand the meritorious [procedure] during the time of self-study, as I tell it today, O Rāma.

1.64.s:
.. śaṅkara uvāca .. ..
ādau deśe tathā rāma prayataḥ susamāhitaḥ ..
svādhyāyenārcayeddevaṃ prayatenāntarātmanā .. 1 ..
1.64.d:
॥ शङ्कर उवाच ॥ ॥
आदौ देशे तथा राम प्रयतः सुसमाहितः ॥
स्वाध्यायेनार्चयेद्देवं प्रयतेनान्तरात्मना ॥ 1 ॥
1.64.m: Śaṅkara said: / First in that place, O Rāma, purified and very composed, / with a restrained inner self, one should worship the deity through self-study (svādhyāya).

1.64.s:
tāvatkāryaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha svādhyāyaṃ vidhivatsadā ..
yāvadastaṃ gato rāma savitā dīptadīdhitiḥ .. 2 ..
1.64.d:
तावत्कार्यं द्विजश्रेष्ठ स्वाध्यायं विधिवत्सदा ॥
यावदस्तं गतो राम सविता दीप्तदीधितिः ॥ 2 ॥
1.64.m: Self-study is always to be performed according to rule, O best of the twice-born, / until the sun of blazing rays has set, O Rāma.

1.64.s:
tatastvastaṃ gate sūrye svācāntaḥ susamāhitaḥ ..
praviśya devatāveśma nairājyaṃ karma kārayet .. 3 ..
1.64.d:
ततस्त्वस्तं गते सूर्ये स्वाचान्तः सुसमाहितः ॥
प्रविश्य देवतावेश्म नैराज्यं कर्म कारयेत् ॥ 3 ॥
1.64.m: Then, when the sun has set, having sipped water and being well-composed, / having entered the shrine of the deity, he should have the waving of lights (nīrājana) performed.

1.64.s:
pādapīṭhāntakaṃ karma kṛtvā prāguktamañjasā ..
arghyamācamanīyaṃ ca dattvā pādyaṃ ca bhārgava .. 4 ..
1.64.d:
पादपीठान्तकं कर्म कृत्वा प्रागुक्तमञ्जसा ॥
अर्घ्यमाचमनीयं च दत्त्वा पाद्यं च भार्गव ॥ 4 ॥
1.64.m: Having quickly performed the rite ending with the footstool, as stated previously, / and having given water for hospitality, water for sipping, and water for the feet, O Bhārgava,
beginning from the pot of unmoistened food-offering, what was stated thereafter / is to be performed up to the follow-up worship, pure and well-composed.

1.64.s:
kṛtvānuyāgaṃ vidhivatpraviśya suramandiram ..
svādhyāyasyānusaṃdhānaṃ tataḥ kuryātsamāhitaḥ .. 6 ..
1.64.d:
कृत्वानुयागं विधिवत्प्रविश्य सुरमन्दिरम् ॥
स्वाध्यायस्यानुसंधानं ततः कुर्यात्समाहितः ॥ 6 ॥
1.64.m: Having performed the follow-up worship according to rule and entered the temple of the gods, / collected in mind, he should then undertake the practice of self-study.
Having taken up the time for yoga, he should afterwards perform the dismissal. / Having performed the dismissal, concentrated, he should remain vigilant for a watch [of the night].

1.64.s:
yogādanantaraṃ svapyādevaṃ yuktasya bhārgava..
svayaṃ kālo'pi satataṃ yogamadhye'bhidhīyate .. 8 ..
1.64.d:
योगादनन्तरं स्वप्यादेवं युक्तस्य भार्गव॥
स्वयं कालोऽपि सततं योगमध्येऽभिधीयते ॥ 8 ॥
1.64.m: After yoga, he should sleep; for one who is thus concentrated, O Bhārgava, / his very period [of sleep] is also perpetually counted as within yoga.

1.64.s:
snānārhakatvaṃ yadi nāsti tasya yāme vibuddhastu tathā caturthe ..
yuñjīta yogaṃ ripukālabhūtaṃ yogena buddhiḥ samupaiti sargam ..9..
1.64.d:
स्नानार्हकत्वं यदि नास्ति तस्य यामे विबुद्धस्तु तथा चतुर्थे ॥
युञ्जीत योगं रिपुकालभूतं योगेन बुद्धिः समुपैति सर्गम् ॥9॥
1.64.m: If he does not have fitness for bathing, having awakened in the fourth watch [of the night], / he should apply himself to yoga, which has become the destroyer of enemies; through yoga the intellect attains creation.

1.65.s:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
jānutulyaṃ mṛduśubhaṃ cailājinakuśottaram ..
śucau deśe pratiṣṭhāpya sthiramāsanamātmanaḥ .. 1..
1.65.d:
शङ्कर उवाच ॥
जानुतुल्यं मृदुशुभं चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम् ॥
शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्थिरमासनमात्मनः ॥ 1॥
1.65.m: Śaṅkara said: / Knee-high, soft, auspicious, covered with cloth, deerskin, and kuśa grass, / establishing his own firm seat in a pure place,

1.65.s:
caturṇāmāsanānāṃ ca baddhvā tatraikamāsanam ..
yogaṃ yuñjīta vidhivadyathāvadunupūrvaśaḥ .. 2 ..
1.65.d:
चतुर्णामासनानां च बद्ध्वा तत्रैकमासनम् ॥
योगं युञ्जीत विधिवद्यथावदुनुपूर्वशः ॥ 2 ॥
1.65.m: and assuming one posture out of the four postures there, / he should practice yoga according to rule, properly and in due order.

1.65.s:
rāma uvāca ..
yogāsanāni catvāri bhagavankāni brūhi me ..
yeṣāmekamathāsthāya yogaṃ yuñjīta mānavaḥ .. 3 ..
1.65.d:
राम उवाच ॥
योगासनानि चत्वारि भगवन्कानि ब्रूहि मे ॥
येषामेकमथास्थाय योगं युञ्जीत मानवः ॥ 3 ॥
1.65.m: Rāma said: / O Lord, tell me what are the four yoga postures, / assuming one of which a man should practice yoga.

1.65.s:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
svastikaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ paryaṅkaṃ kamalāsanam ..
yogāsanāni catvāri teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam .. 4 ..
1.65.d:
शङ्कर उवाच ॥
स्वस्तिकं सर्वतोभद्रं पर्यङ्कं कमलासनम् ॥
योगासनानि चत्वारि तेषां वक्ष्यामि लक्षणम् ॥ 4 ॥
1.65.m: Śaṅkara said: / Svastika, sarvatobhadra, paryaṅka, and kamalāsana— / these are the four yoga postures; I shall declare their characteristics.

1.65.s:
āsanne jānunī kṛtvā yathāvatsusamāhitaḥ ..
vāmaṃ kṛtvetare pāde vāmajaṅghorupīḍitam .. 5..
1.65.d:
आसन्ने जानुनी कृत्वा यथावत्सुसमाहितः ॥
वामं कृत्वेतरे पादे वामजङ्घोरुपीडितम् ॥ 5॥
1.65.m: Having brought the two knees close, properly and well-composed, / placing the left [foot] on the other foot, pressed between the left shank and thigh,

1.65.s:
svastikaṃ nāma tatproktamāsanaṃ prathamaṃ śubham ..
ūrū ca jānunī jaṅghe yatrāsanagataḥ samam ..6..
1.65.d:
स्वस्तिकं नाम तत्प्रोक्तमासनं प्रथमं शुभम् ॥
ऊरू च जानुनी जङ्घे यत्रासनगतः समम् ॥6॥
1.65.m: that is proclaimed as the first auspicious posture, named svastika. / Where the two thighs, the two knees, and the two shanks, seated on the posture, are level,

1.65.s:
āsanaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ tadviddhi manujottama ..
paryaṅke yogapaṭṭena badhnīyātpṛṣṭhayogataḥ .. 7 ..
1.65.d:
आसनं सर्वतोभद्रं तद्विद्धि मनुजोत्तम ॥
पर्यङ्के योगपट्टेन बध्नीयात्पृष्ठयोगतः ॥ 7 ॥
1.65.m: know that posture to be sarvatobhadra, O best of men. / In paryaṅka, one should bind [oneself] with a yoga strap across the back.

1.65.s:
ākuñcya jānunī samyakpādaṃ kṛtvā ca bāhyataḥ ..
dakṣiṇaṃ vāmajaṅghāyāṃ paryaṅkāsanakāraṇam .. 8..
1.65.d:
आकुञ्च्य जानुनी सम्यक्पादं कृत्वा च बाह्यतः ॥
दक्षिणं वामजङ्घायां पर्यङ्कासनकारणम् ॥ 8॥
1.65.m: Having bent both knees completely and placed the foot outside, / the right one on the left shank, forms the paryaṅka posture.

1.65.s:
āsane sarvatobhadre yadā bhavati mānavaḥ ..
ūrusthottānacaraṇastadā syātkamalāsanam .. 9 ..
1.65.d:
आसने सर्वतोभद्रे यदा भवति मानवः ॥
ऊरुस्थोत्तानचरणस्तदा स्यात्कमलासनम् ॥ 9 ॥
1.65.m: When a man sits in the sarvatobhadra seat / with his feet upturned on his thighs, that becomes the lotus seat.

1.65.s:
āsanasthasya karaṇaṃ nibodha gadato mama..
samānīyorumūlena hastau bhārgava tiryagau..1.65.10..
1.65.d:
आसनस्थस्य करणं निबोध गदतो मम॥
समानीयोरुमूलेन हस्तौ भार्गव तिर्यगौ॥1.65.10॥
1.65.m: Hear from me as I describe the bodily posture of one sitting in that seat: / bringing the hands level with the root of the thighs across them, O descendant of Bhṛgu,

1.65.s:
kṛtvottānau samau vidvānvāmasyopari dakṣiṇam..
aṅgulīcchādakaṃ vidvānaṅgulī nāṃ tu vinyaset .. 11 ...
1.65.d:
कृत्वोत्तानौ समौ विद्वान्वामस्योपरि दक्षिणम्॥
अङ्गुलीच्छादकं विद्वानङ्गुली नां तु विन्यसेत् ॥ 11 ॥।
1.65.m: the wise man, having turned both upward and level, / should place the right above the left, covering the fingers with the fingers.

1.65.s:
kiñcidākuñcitāṅguṣṭhau kartavyau ca tathā karau ..
uraścotthāpya vitataṃ kṛtvā rāma pariślatham .. 12..
1.65.d:
किञ्चिदाकुञ्चिताङ्गुष्ठौ कर्तव्यौ च तथा करौ ॥
उरश्चोत्थाप्य विततं कृत्वा राम परिश्लथम् ॥ 12॥
1.65.m: The two hands should have the thumbs slightly bent; / and raising the chest, making it broad and relaxed, O Rāma,

1.65.s:
pṛṣṭhamākuñcayetskandhe dehamunnāmayetsudhīḥ ..
niṣkampāṃ sudṛḍhāmṛjvīṃ nātistabdhāṃ na kuñcitām .. 13..
1.65.d:
पृष्ठमाकुञ्चयेत्स्कन्धे देहमुन्नामयेत्सुधीः ॥
निष्कम्पां सुदृढामृज्वीं नातिस्तब्धां न कुञ्चिताम् ॥ 13॥
1.65.m: the wise man should contract the back at the shoulder and elevate the body, / holding the neck steady, very firm, straight, neither too rigid nor bent,

1.65.s:
grīvāṃ vidhārayedyatnācchiraḥ kāryaṃ samaṃ sadā ..
saṃpasyannāsikāgraṃ svaṃ diśaścānavalokayan .. 14..
1.65.d:
ग्रीवां विधारयेद्यत्नाच्छिरः कार्यं समं सदा ॥
संपस्यन्नासिकाग्रं स्वं दिशश्चानवलोकयन् ॥ 14॥
1.65.m: with effort; the head should always be held straight, / looking at the tip of one's own nose and not looking at the directions.

1.65.s:
kiñcinnimīlite netre dantairdantānna saṃspṛśet ..
tālumadhyagatenaiva jihvāgreṇa samāhitaḥ .. 19..
1.65.d:
किञ्चिन्निमीलिते नेत्रे दन्तैर्दन्तान्न संस्पृशेत् ॥
तालुमध्यगतेनैव जिह्वाग्रेण समाहितः ॥ 19॥
1.65.m: With eyes slightly closed, he should not touch teeth to teeth; / concentrated, with the tip of the tongue placed at the middle of the palate,

1.65.s:
sa baddhakaraṇo vidvānabhyāsātpavanaṃ jayet ..
jitvā vāyuṃ yathāśakti yogaṃ yuñjīta buddhimān .. 16 ..
1.65.d:
स बद्धकरणो विद्वानभ्यासात्पवनं जयेत् ॥
जित्वा वायुं यथाशक्ति योगं युञ्जीत बुद्धिमान् ॥ 16 ॥
1.65.m: having formed this posture, the wise man should master the breath through practice. / Having conquered the breath according to his capacity, the intelligent man should apply yoga.

1.65.s:
ādau tu cintayetsthūlāṃ bhūmiṃ pañcaguṇānvitām ..
labdhalakṣo mahāyogī bhūmiyogaṃ samutsṛjet .. 17 ..
1.65.d:
आदौ तु चिन्तयेत्स्थूलां भूमिं पञ्चगुणान्विताम् ॥
लब्धलक्षो महायोगी भूमियोगं समुत्सृजेत् ॥ 17 ॥
1.65.m: First, however, he should meditate on the gross earth, endowed with five qualities; / having attained his aim, the great yogin should abandon yoga on the earth.

1.65.s:
tataścaturguṇaṃ dhyānaṃ kartavyamudake dvija ..
labdhalakṣa apāṃ yogī jalayogaṃ samutsṛjet .. 18 ...
1.65.d:
ततश्चतुर्गुणं ध्यानं कर्तव्यमुदके द्विज ॥
लब्धलक्ष अपां योगी जलयोगं समुत्सृजेत् ॥ 18 ॥।
1.65.m: Then, O twice-born, meditation endowed with four qualities should be performed on water; / having attained his aim regarding the waters, the yogin should abandon yoga on water.

1.65.s:
tatastu yogaṃ yuñjīta triguṇaṃ dvija tejasi ..
labdhalakṣaśca tatrāpi vahniyogaṃ samutsṛjet .. 19 ..
1.65.d:
ततस्तु योगं युञ्जीत त्रिगुणं द्विज तेजसि ॥
लब्धलक्षश्च तत्रापि वह्नियोगं समुत्सृजेत् ॥ 19 ॥
1.65.m: Then, O twice-born, he should apply yoga endowed with three qualities to fire; / and having attained his aim there as well, he should abandon yoga on fire.

1.65.s:
tatastu yogaṃ yuñjīta pavane dviguṇaṃ dvija ....
labdhalakṣaśca tatrāpi vāyuyogaṃ samutsṛjet .. 1.65.20 ...
1.65.d:
ततस्तु योगं युञ्जीत पवने द्विगुणं द्विज ॥॥
लब्धलक्षश्च तत्रापि वायुयोगं समुत्सृजेत् ॥ 1.65.20 ॥।
1.65.m: Then, O twice-born, he should apply yoga endowed with two qualities to wind; / and having attained his aim there as well, he should abandon yoga on wind.

1.65.s:
tatastvekaguṇaṃ yogaṃ yuñjīta gagane budhaḥ ..
labdhalakṣaśca tatrāpi manoyogagatirbhavet .. 21 ..
1.65.d:
ततस्त्वेकगुणं योगं युञ्जीत गगने बुधः ॥
लब्धलक्षश्च तत्रापि मनोयोगगतिर्भवेत् ॥ 21 ॥
1.65.m: Then the wise man should apply yoga endowed with one quality to space; / and having attained his aim there as well, his practice becomes yoga of the mind.

1.65.s:
manasaścandramāḥ proktaḥ prathamaṃ candramaṇḍale ..
ūrdhvalakṣaṃ budhaḥ kṛtvā candramaṇḍalamadhyage .. 22 ..
1.65.d:
मनसश्चन्द्रमाः प्रोक्तः प्रथमं चन्द्रमण्डले ॥
ऊर्ध्वलक्षं बुधः कृत्वा चन्द्रमण्डलमध्यगे ॥ 22 ॥
1.65.m: The moon is said to belong to the mind; first, in the lunar orb, / having fixed his aim above, in the middle of the lunar orb,

1.65.s:
aṅguṣṭhamātre puruṣe lakṣabandhaṃ tu kārayet ..
śaśāṅkaśatasaṃkāśe sarvālaṅkārabhūṣite..23..
1.65.d:
अङ्गुष्ठमात्रे पुरुषे लक्षबन्धं तु कारयेत् ॥
शशाङ्कशतसंकाशे सर्वालङ्कारभूषिते॥23॥
1.65.m: the wise man should fix his focus on a person the size of a thumb, / resembling a hundred moons, adorned with all ornaments.

1.65.s:
labdhalakṣaśca tatrāpi buddhiyogagatirbhavet..
buddhiśca bhagavānsūryaḥ prathamaṃ sūryamaṇḍale..24..
1.65.d:
लब्धलक्षश्च तत्रापि बुद्धियोगगतिर्भवेत्॥
बुद्धिश्च भगवान्सूर्यः प्रथमं सूर्यमण्डले॥24॥
1.65.m: Having attained his aim there as well, his practice becomes yoga of the intellect; / and the intellect is the lord Sun; first, in the solar orb,

1.65.s:
samagrameva saṃpaśyeddhyānayogena buddhimān..
sūryamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ śatasūryasamaprabham..25..
1.65.d:
समग्रमेव संपश्येद्ध्यानयोगेन बुद्धिमान्॥
सूर्यमण्डलमध्यस्थं शतसूर्यसमप्रभम्॥25॥
1.65.m: the intelligent man should perceive it entirely through the yoga of meditation, / standing in the midst of the solar orb, having the brilliance of a hundred suns,

1.65.s:
aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam ..
cintayetprayato nāma tatparaḥ susamāhitaḥ .. 26 ...
1.65.d:
अङ्गुष्ठमात्रं पुरुषं सर्वाभरणभूषितम् ॥
चिन्तयेत्प्रयतो नाम तत्परः सुसमाहितः ॥ 26 ॥।
1.65.m: a person the size of a thumb, adorned with all ornaments; / restrained, intent on that, and well concentrated, he should meditate.

1.65.s:
labdhalakṣaśca tatrāpi nityamātmānamātmanā ..
ātmasthameva s saṃpaśyeddhyānayogena bhārgava .. 27 ..
1.65.d:
लब्धलक्षश्च तत्रापि नित्यमात्मानमात्मना ॥
आत्मस्थमेव स् संपश्येद्ध्यानयोगेन भार्गव ॥ 27 ॥
1.65.m: Having attained his aim there as well, he should always see the Self by the Self, / dwelling within the Self, through the yoga of meditation, O descendant of Bhṛgu.

1.65.s:
aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ sūryabimbagataṃ yathā ..
dhyānayogena saṃpaśyettathā paśyettathātmani .. 28 ..
1.65.d:
अङ्गुष्ठमात्रं पुरुषं सूर्यबिम्बगतं यथा ॥
ध्यानयोगेन संपश्येत्तथा पश्येत्तथात्मनि ॥ 28 ॥
1.65.m: Just as he sees through the yoga of meditation the person the size of a thumb / situated within the solar orb, so he should see him within himself,

1.65.s:
adhomukhe hṛtkamale karṇikāyāṃ bhṛgūttama..
labdhalakṣaśca tatrāpi avyaktaṃ cintayetpadam..29..
1.65.d:
अधोमुखे हृत्कमले कर्णिकायां भृगूत्तम॥
लब्धलक्षश्च तत्रापि अव्यक्तं चिन्तयेत्पदम्॥29॥
1.65.m: in the downward-facing lotus of the heart, upon the pericarp, O foremost of the Bhṛgus; / and having attained his aim there as well, he should meditate on the unmanifest state.

1.65.s:
bahirantaśca sarvatra tejasā tatra cintayet ..
naivārkeṇa na candreṇa sarvaṃ vyāptamaśeṣataḥ .. 1.65.30 ...
1.65.d:
बहिरन्तश्च सर्वत्र तेजसा तत्र चिन्तयेत् ॥
नैवार्केण न चन्द्रेण सर्वं व्याप्तमशेषतः ॥ 1.65.30 ॥।
1.65.m: He should meditate on that which pervades everything without remainder, both outside and inside, / everywhere with light—neither by the sun nor by the moon.

1.65.s:
labdhalakṣaśca tatrāpi puruṣaṃ cintayetparam ..
śūnyaṃ tu puruṣaṃ dhyānaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ .. 31 ....
1.65.d:
लब्धलक्षश्च तत्रापि पुरुषं चिन्तयेत्परम् ॥
शून्यं तु पुरुषं ध्यानं प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः ॥ 31 ॥॥
1.65.m: Having attained his aim there as well, he should meditate on the supreme person; / the wise proclaim meditation on the person as the void.

1.65.s:
sākāre baddhalakṣastu śūnyaṃ śaknoti cintitum ..
anyathā tu sukaṣṭaṃ syānnirālambasya cintanam .. 32..
1.65.d:
साकारे बद्धलक्षस्तु शून्यं शक्नोति चिन्तितुम् ॥
अन्यथा तु सुकष्टं स्यान्निरालम्बस्य चिन्तनम् ॥ 32॥
1.65.m: One who has fixed his aim on that which has form is able to meditate on the void; / otherwise, meditation on that which is without support would be very difficult.

1.65.s:
cittavṛttinirodho hi duṣkaraḥ pratibhāti me ..
tatra yatnaḥ sadā kāryo vijaye pavanasya ca .. 33 ..
1.65.d:
चित्तवृत्तिनिरोधो हि दुष्करः प्रतिभाति मे ॥
तत्र यत्नः सदा कार्यो विजये पवनस्य च ॥ 33 ॥
1.65.m: Indeed, the restraint of the fluctuations of the mind seems difficult to me; / effort should always be made toward that and toward the mastery of the breath.

1.65.s:
cittavṛttinirodhena pavanasya jayena ca ..
upāsanāyā śūnyasya niṣphalatvaṃ vidhīyate .. 34 ..
1.65.d:
चित्तवृत्तिनिरोधेन पवनस्य जयेन च ॥
उपासनाया शून्यस्य निष्फलत्वं विधीयते ॥ 34 ॥
1.65.m: By the restraint of the fluctuations of the mind and by the mastery of the breath, / fruitlessness is prescribed for the worship of the void.

1.65.s:
arūpagandhamanasaṃ śabdasparśavivarjitam ..
sarvendriyaguṇaṃ rāma sarvasthaṃ sarvagaṃ ca yat ..35..
1.65.d:
अरूपगन्धमनसं शब्दस्पर्शविवर्जितम् ॥
सर्वेन्द्रियगुणं राम सर्वस्थं सर्वगं च यत् ॥35॥
1.65.m: Devoid of form, smell, and mind, free from sound and touch, / possessing the qualities of all senses, dwelling in all, and all-pervading, O Rāma—

1.65.s:
( taṃ dhyāyanpuruṣaṃ tasya dhyānaṃ śūnyaṃ prakīrtitam .. )
tasya svarūpaṃ vijñāya rāma śūnyamupāsataḥ .. 36 ..
1.65.d:
( तं ध्यायन्पुरुषं तस्य ध्यानं शून्यं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ )
तस्य स्वरूपं विज्ञाय राम शून्यमुपासतः ॥ 36 ॥
1.65.m: (meditating on that person, his meditation is proclaimed to be the void)— / knowing the true nature of that, O Rāma, for one who worships the void,

1.65.s:
sarvabandhanamuktasya niṣphalatvaṃ vidhīyate ..
akhaṇḍakāriṇastvevaṃ nityaṃ bhṛgukulodvaha .. 37 ..
1.65.d:
सर्वबन्धनमुक्तस्य निष्फलत्वं विधीयते ॥
अखण्डकारिणस्त्वेवं नित्यं भृगुकुलोद्वह ॥ 37 ॥
1.65.m: freed from all bonds, fruitlessness is prescribed / for one who acts continuously in this manner, O scion of the Bhṛgu family.

1.65.s:
saṃvatsaraśate pūrṇe satribhāge mahābhuja ..
niṣphalatvaṃ paraṃ sthānaṃ dhruvaṃ bhavati bhārgava .. 38 ..
1.65.d:
संवत्सरशते पूर्णे सत्रिभागे महाभुज ॥
निष्फलत्वं परं स्थानं ध्रुवं भवति भार्गव ॥ 38 ॥
1.65.m: When a full hundred years together with a third part are completed, O mighty-armed one, / the fruitlessness, the supreme abode, certainly comes to be, O descendant of Bhṛgu.

1.65.s:
rāma uvāca ..
saṃvatsaraśataṃ pūrṇaṃ tribhāgasahitaṃ vibho ..
ajīvato niṣphalatvaṃ kathaṃ bhavati śaṅkara .. 39 ..
1.65.d:
राम उवाच ॥
संवत्सरशतं पूर्णं त्रिभागसहितं विभो ॥
अजीवतो निष्फलत्वं कथं भवति शङ्कर ॥ 39 ॥
1.65.m: Rāma said: / When one does not live for a full hundred years together with a third part, O Lord, / how does fruitlessness come about, O Śaṅkara?

1.65.s:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
akhaṇḍakārī bhavati yadyekamapi janmani ..
janmakramādavaśyaṃ hi rāma janmanijanmani .. 1.65.40 ..
1.65.d:
शङ्कर उवाच ॥
अखण्डकारी भवति यद्येकमपि जन्मनि ॥
जन्मक्रमादवश्यं हि राम जन्मनिजन्मनि ॥ 1.65.40 ॥
1.65.m: Śaṅkara said: / If one acts continuously even in a single birth, / then inevitably in the course of rebirths, O Rāma, birth after birth,

1.65.s:
pūraṇīyaṃ satribhāgaṃ dhruvaṃ tena samāḥ śatam ..
anekajanmasaṃsiddhastato yāti parāṃ gatim .. 41 ..
1.65.d:
पूरणीयं सत्रिभागं ध्रुवं तेन समाः शतम् ॥
अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥ 41 ॥
1.65.m: a hundred years with a third part will surely be completed by him; / perfected through many births, he then goes to the supreme state.

1.65.s:
akhaṇḍakāriṇo rāma pravṛttasya dvijanmanaḥ ..
avaśyameva tatsthānaṃ yadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam .. 42 ..
1.65.d:
अखण्डकारिणो राम प्रवृत्तस्य द्विजन्मनः ॥
अवश्यमेव तत्स्थानं यद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् ॥ 42 ॥
1.65.m: For a twice-born person who engages in this and acts continuously, O Rāma, / that abode which is the supreme state of Viṣṇu is certainly attained.

1.65.s:
rāma uvāca ..
akhaṇḍakāritā proktā tvayā deva dvijanmanām ..
śūdro vā yadi vā nārī kathaṃ sthānamavāpnuyāt .. 43 ..
1.65.d:
राम उवाच ॥
अखण्डकारिता प्रोक्ता त्वया देव द्विजन्मनाम् ॥
शूद्रो वा यदि वा नारी कथं स्थानमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 43 ॥
1.65.m: Rāma said: / Continuous practice has been declared by you, O lord, for the twice-born; / how can a śūdra or a woman attain that state?

1.65.s:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
akhaṇḍakāriṇī patnī prāpnoti paramaṃ padam ..
śūdraḥ svakarmanirataḥ keśavārpitamānasaḥ .. 44..
1.65.d:
शङ्कर उवाच ॥
अखण्डकारिणी पत्नी प्राप्नोति परमं पदम् ॥
शूद्रः स्वकर्मनिरतः केशवार्पितमानसः ॥ 44॥
1.65.m: Śaṅkara said: / A wife who acts continuously attains the supreme state; / a śūdra devoted to his own duty, whose mind is offered to Keśava,

1.65.s:
jātyantaramathāsādya bhaktiyogena bhāvitaḥ ..
akhaṇḍakārī bhavati tataḥ prāpnoti tatpadam .. 49 ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ...
etāvaduktaṃ devena tryambakeṇa mahātmanā ..
tadā tuṣṭena rāmāya rahasyamṛṣipūjitam .. 16..
etadbalivihīnāya na tu vācyaṃ yadūttam ..
na nāstikāya mūrkhāya tarkaduṣṭāya vā tathā .. 47..
etattu śṛṇvate vācyaṃ śiṣyāya ca sutāya ca ..
yo vā dadyānmahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ saśailavanakānanām .. 48 ..
etadguhyaṃ paraṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam ..
āyuṣyaṃ ca yaśasyaṃ ca kaliduḥsvapnanāśanam .. 49..
1.65.d:
जात्यन्तरमथासाद्य भक्तियोगेन भावितः ॥
अखण्डकारी भवति ततः प्राप्नोति तत्पदम् ॥ 49 ॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥।
एतावदुक्तं देवेन त्र्यम्बकेण महात्मना ॥
तदा तुष्टेन रामाय रहस्यमृषिपूजितम् ॥ 16॥
एतद्बलिविहीनाय न तु वाच्यं यदूत्तम् ॥
न नास्तिकाय मूर्खाय तर्कदुष्टाय वा तथा ॥ 47॥
एतत्तु शृण्वते वाच्यं शिष्याय च सुताय च ॥
यो वा दद्यान्महीं कृत्स्नां सशैलवनकाननाम् ॥ 48 ॥
एतद्गुह्यं परं पुण्यं पवित्रं पापनाशनम् ॥
आयुष्यं च यशस्यं च कलिदुःस्वप्ननाशनम् ॥ 49॥
1.65.m:
then having reached another birth, refined by the yoga of devotion, / becomes one who acts continuously, and then attains that state.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / This much was spoken to Rāma by the exalted god Tryambaka, / who was pleased at that time—a secret revered by the sages.
This must not be spoken to one devoid of strength, O best of the Yadus, / nor to an atheist, a fool, or one corrupted by disputation.
This, however, should be spoken to a disciple who listens and to a son, / or to one who would give the entire earth with its mountains and forests.
This is a supreme secret, meritorious, purifying, destroying sin, / granting long life and renown, and destroying bad dreams in the Kali age.

1.65.s:
adhyetavyamidaṃ samyagvacanaṃ śaṃkarasya ca ..
sarvabandhavinirmuktaḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ padam .. 1.65.50 ..
1.65.d:
अध्येतव्यमिदं सम्यग्वचनं शंकरस्य च ॥
सर्वबन्धविनिर्मुक्तः प्राप्नोति परमं पदम् ॥ 1.65.50 ॥
1.65.m: This teaching of Śaṅkara should be studied thoroughly; / freed from all bonds, one attains the supreme state.

1.65.s:
etāvaduktaṃ tripurāntakena tuṣṭena rāmasya mahābalasya ..
mayā tathā te'bhihitaṃ narendra dhāryaṃ tvayedaṃ satataṃ yathāvat .. 91 ..
1.65.d:
एतावदुक्तं त्रिपुरान्तकेन तुष्टेन रामस्य महाबलस्य ॥
मया तथा तेऽभिहितं नरेन्द्र धार्यं त्वयेदं सततं यथावत् ॥ 91 ॥
1.65.m: This much was spoken by the destroyer of Tripura, well-pleased, to Rāma of great power; / in the same way it has been spoken by me to you, O king; this should be retained by you constantly and properly.

1.66.s:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ... ..
kailāsaśikhare ramye rāmasya ramatastadā ..
ājagāma haraṃ draṣṭuṃ devadevaḥ purandaraḥ .. 1 ..
1.66.d:
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥॥।
कैलासशिखरे रम्ये रामस्य रमतस्तदा ॥
आजगाम हरं द्रष्टुं देवदेवः पुरन्दरः ॥ 1 ॥
1.66.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / While Rāma was then taking pleasure on the delightful peak of Kailāsa, / Purandara, god of gods, came to see Hara.

1.66.s:
sa samāsādya deveśaṃ praṇamya vṛṣabhadhvajam ..
uvāca vacanaṃ samyaṅmudā rāmasya sannidhau .. 2 ..
1.66.d:
स समासाद्य देवेशं प्रणम्य वृषभध्वजम् ॥
उवाच वचनं सम्यङ्मुदा रामस्य सन्निधौ ॥ 2 ॥
1.66.m: Having approached the lord of the gods and bowed down to the one who has the bull on his banner, / he spoke well with joy in the presence of Rāma:

1.66.s:
śakra uvāca ..
tvatprasādena deveśa mayā prāptaṃ triviṣṭapam ..
rāmeṇa ghātitāḥ sarve yathā me devaśatravaḥ .. 3 ..
1.66.d:
शक्र उवाच ॥
त्वत्प्रसादेन देवेश मया प्राप्तं त्रिविष्टपम् ॥
रामेण घातिताः सर्वे यथा मे देवशत्रवः ॥ 3 ॥
1.66.m: Śakra said: / By your grace, O lord of the gods, I attained the celestial world, / in that all the enemies of the gods were slain for me by Rāma.

1.66.s:
avadhyāstridaśānāṃ ye varadānabaloddhatāḥ ..
naravadhyāḥ kṛtāste hi brahmaṇā sumahātmanā .. 4 ..
1.66.d:
अवध्यास्त्रिदशानां ये वरदानबलोद्धताः ॥
नरवध्याः कृतास्ते हि ब्रह्मणा सुमहात्मना ॥ 4 ॥
1.66.m: Those who cannot be killed by the thirty [gods], arrogant with the power of boons granted, / were indeed made liable to be killed by man by the supreme Great-souled Brahmā.

1.66.s:
pātālanilayā deva avadhyā devatāgaṇaiḥ ..
bādhante naravadhyā me lokānāṃ ca jagatpate .. 5 ..
1.66.d:
पातालनिलया देव अवध्या देवतागणैः ॥
बाधन्ते नरवध्या मे लोकानां च जगत्पते ॥ 5 ॥
1.66.m: Dwelling in the netherworld, O god, unslayable by the hosts of deities, / those [demons] liable to be killed by man harass my worlds, O lord of the world.

1.66.s:
tāṃśca ghātaya deveśa rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
evaṃ kariṣyatītyuktvā visṛjya tridaśeśvaram .. 6 ..
1.66.d:
तांश्च घातय देवेश रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा ॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
एवं करिष्यतीत्युक्त्वा विसृज्य त्रिदशेश्वरम् ॥ 6 ॥
1.66.m: Slay them also, O lord of the gods, through Rāma of unwearied action. / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having said, "He will do so," and having dismissed the lord of the thirty [gods],

1.66.s:
uvāca vacanaṃ rāmaṃ bhārgavaṃ purataḥ sthitam ..
śaṅkara uvāca ..
gaccha bhārgava pātālaṃ pātālanilayāñjahi .. 7 ..
1.66.d:
उवाच वचनं रामं भार्गवं पुरतः स्थितम् ॥
शङ्कर उवाच ॥
गच्छ भार्गव पातालं पातालनिलयाञ्जहि ॥ 7 ॥
1.66.m: he addressed his speech to Rāma, the Bhārgava, who stood before him. / Śaṅkara said: / Go, O Bhārgava, to the netherworld, and slay those who dwell in the netherworld,

1.66.s:
śakraśatrūndurācārānnaravadhyānmahāsurān..
vaiṣṇavaṃ cāparatnaṃ te mayā nyastaṃ pituḥ kare ..8..
1.66.d:
शक्रशत्रून्दुराचारान्नरवध्यान्महासुरान्॥
वैष्णवं चापरत्नं ते मया न्यस्तं पितुः करे ॥8॥
1.66.m: the great asuras of wicked conduct, enemies of Śakra, who are to be killed by man. / And the jewel of a Vaiṣṇava bow was placed by me in your father's hand.

1.66.s:
tadādāya śaraistīkṣṇairjahi tānrāma dānavān ..
akṣayaṃ tūṇamādāya śarapūrṇamidaṃ tathā .. 9 ..
1.66.d:
तदादाय शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्जहि तान्राम दानवान् ॥
अक्षयं तूणमादाय शरपूर्णमिदं तथा ॥ 9 ॥
1.66.m: Taking that, slay those dānavas with sharp arrows, O Rāma, / taking likewise this inexhaustible quiver full of arrows.

1.66.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ...
evamuktvā dadau cāsya tūṇamakṣayasāyakam ..
dattvā ca bhagavānāha rāmaṃ parabalārdanam .. 1.66.10 ..
1.66.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥।
एवमुक्त्वा ददौ चास्य तूणमक्षयसायकम् ॥
दत्त्वा च भगवानाह रामं परबलार्दनम् ॥ 1.66.10 ॥
1.66.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having spoken thus, he gave him a quiver of inexhaustible arrows; / and having given it, the Lord said to Rāma, the crusher of the enemy's armies:

1.66.s:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
tūṇametatpradātavyaṃ tvayāgastyāya bhārgava ..
cāparatnaṃ ca rāmāya kṛte karmaṇi suvrata .. 11 ..
1.66.d:
शङ्कर उवाच ॥
तूणमेतत्प्रदातव्यं त्वयागस्त्याय भार्गव ॥
चापरत्नं च रामाय कृते कर्मणि सुव्रत ॥ 11 ॥
1.66.m: Śaṅkara said: / This quiver should be given by you to Agastya, O Bhārgava, / and the jewel of a bow to Rāma, when the deed is accomplished, O you of noble vows.
Agastya also, of great splendour, will give the quiver of inexhaustible arrows / to Rāma, the descendant of Raghu, who possesses supreme fame.

1.66.s:
rāmasaṃdarśanādūrdhvaṃ mā kṛthāḥ śastradhāraṇam ..
rāmasaṃdarśane rāma tava tejo hi vaiṣṇavam .. 13 ..
1.66.d:
रामसंदर्शनादूर्ध्वं मा कृथाः शस्त्रधारणम् ॥
रामसंदर्शने राम तव तेजो हि वैष्णवम् ॥ 13 ॥
1.66.m: After seeing Rāma, do not bear weapons; / for upon seeing Rāma, your Vaiṣṇava splendour, O Rāma,

1.66.s:
rāmaṃ pravekṣyati tadā surakāryārthamūrjitam ..
yāvattvaṃ tejasā yukto vaiṣṇavena paraṃtapa .. 14 ..
1.66.d:
रामं प्रवेक्ष्यति तदा सुरकार्यार्थमूर्जितम् ॥
यावत्त्वं तेजसा युक्तो वैष्णवेन परंतप ॥ 14 ॥
1.66.m: will then enter Rāma, mighty for the sake of the gods' purpose. / As long as you are endowed with the Vaiṣṇava splendour, O scorcher of foes,

1.66.s:
tāvacchatrugaṇānsarvānsamareṣu vijeṣyasi ..
sthātuṃ na śaktāstava daityasenā astāyudhasya pramukhe dvijendra ..
ādāya cāpaṃ yudhi vaiṣṇavaṃ tattūṇaṃ tathemaṃ jahi devaśatrūn .. 19 ..
1.66.d:
तावच्छत्रुगणान्सर्वान्समरेषु विजेष्यसि ॥
स्थातुं न शक्तास्तव दैत्यसेना अस्तायुधस्य प्रमुखे द्विजेन्द्र ॥
आदाय चापं युधि वैष्णवं तत्तूणं तथेमं जहि देवशत्रून् ॥ 19 ॥
1.66.m: so long will you conquer all hosts of enemies in battles. / The army of the daityas is not able to stand before you who have cast your weapons, O foremost of twice-born; / taking that Vaiṣṇava bow in battle and likewise this quiver, slay the enemies of the gods.

1.67.s:
rāma uvāca ...
vaiṣṇavaṃ cāparatnaṃ tatkimarthaṃ bhavatā kare ..
nyastaṃ ca tanme bhagavaṃścāparatnaṃ ca kīdṛśam .. 1 ..
1.67.d:
राम उवाच ॥।
वैष्णवं चापरत्नं तत्किमर्थं भवता करे ॥
न्यस्तं च तन्मे भगवंश्चापरत्नं च कीदृशम् ॥ 1 ॥
1.67.m: Rāma said: / For what reason was that jewel of a Vaiṣṇava bow placed in the hand [of my father] by you, / and of what kind is that jewel of a bow, O Lord? Tell me that.

1.67.s:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
māyā hi vaiṣṇavī rāma yayā saṃmohitāḥ purā ..
devāśca ṛṣayaścaiva gatvāntaḥ praṇatāḥ sthitā .. 2 ..
1.67.d:
शङ्कर उवाच ॥
माया हि वैष्णवी राम यया संमोहिताः पुरा ॥
देवाश्च ऋषयश्चैव गत्वान्तः प्रणताः स्थिता ॥ 2 ॥
1.67.m: Śaṅkara said: / The māyā of Viṣṇu, O Rāma, by which they were formerly deluded— / the gods and the ṛṣis, having gone inside, stood bowing down

1.67.s:
yajatāṃ paramādhāraṃ devaṃ kamalasaṃbhavam ..
bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyasya prabhuṃ lokanamaskṛtaḥ .. .. 3..
1.67.d:
यजतां परमाधारं देवं कमलसंभवम् ॥
भूतभव्यभविष्यस्य प्रभुं लोकनमस्कृतः ॥ ॥ 3॥
1.67.m: to the god born of the lotus, the supreme foundation of those who sacrifice, / the master of past, present, and future, reverenced by the world.

1.67.s:
devā ūcuḥ ..
vāsudevasya devasya mahādevasya cāpyatha ..
antaraṃ jñātumicchāmaḥ kaḥ kasmādatiricyate ..4 ..
1.67.d:
देवा ऊचुः ॥
वासुदेवस्य देवस्य महादेवस्य चाप्यथ ॥
अन्तरं ज्ञातुमिच्छामः कः कस्मादतिरिच्यते ॥4 ॥
1.67.m: The gods said: / We wish to know the difference between the god Vāsudeva / and Mahādeva: who surpasses whom?

1.67.s:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
evamuktassuraiḥ sarvairṛṣibhiśca pitāmahaiḥ ..
vihasyovāca tānsarvāṃstayorgatvā parasparam .. 5 ..
1.67.d:
शङ्कर उवाच ॥
एवमुक्तस्सुरैः सर्वैरृषिभिश्च पितामहैः ॥
विहस्योवाच तान्सर्वांस्तयोर्गत्वा परस्परम् ॥ 5 ॥
1.67.m: Śaṅkara said: / Addressed thus by all the gods, the ṛṣis, and the ancestors, / having laughed, he spoke to them all, having approached one another:

1.67.s:
brahmovāca ..
janayadhvaṃ surāḥ sarve virodhamṛṣibhissaha ..
virodhe tu samutpanne tayoryuddhaṃ upasthite .. 6 ..
1.67.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ॥
जनयध्वं सुराः सर्वे विरोधमृषिभिस्सह ॥
विरोधे तु समुत्पन्ने तयोर्युद्धं उपस्थिते ॥ 6 ॥
1.67.m: Brahmā said: / All you gods, generate enmity [between them] together with the ṛṣis; / when enmity has arisen and their battle is at hand,

1.67.s:
jñāsyadhvamantaraṃ devāstayornāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ..
śaṅkara uvāca ..
evamuktāḥ surāḥ sarve sārdhamṛṣigaṇaistadā .. 7 ..
1.67.d:
ज्ञास्यध्वमन्तरं देवास्तयोर्नास्त्यत्र संशयः ॥
शङ्कर उवाच ॥
एवमुक्ताः सुराः सर्वे सार्धमृषिगणैस्तदा ॥ 7 ॥
1.67.m: you will know the difference between the two, O gods; there is no doubt of this. / Śaṅkara said: / Thus addressed, all the gods together with the hosts of ṛṣis then,

1.67.s:
āvayorjanayāmāsurvirodhaṃ bhṛgunandana ..
viṣṇorādhikyamanvicchaṃstasya māyāvimohitāḥ .. 8 ..
1.67.d:
आवयोर्जनयामासुर्विरोधं भृगुनन्दन ॥
विष्णोराधिक्यमन्विच्छंस्तस्य मायाविमोहिताः ॥ 8 ॥
1.67.m: O delight of the Bhṛgus, generated enmity between us, / seeking the superiority of Viṣṇu, deluded by his māyā.

1.67.s:
kṛtavānasmi daivena deva vākyena vigraham ..
prabhāvadarśanārthāya tvāvayorvigrahe tadā .. 9 ..
1.67.d:
कृतवानस्मि दैवेन देव वाक्येन विग्रहम् ॥
प्रभावदर्शनार्थाय त्वावयोर्विग्रहे तदा ॥ 9 ॥
1.67.m: By divine [design], through the word of the god, I engaged in strife. / In order to display our power, in our strife then,

1.67.s:
āsannamabhavadyuddhaṃ sarvasattvabhayaṅkaram ..
āvayorbhṛguśārdūla tadā yuddhe upasthite .. 1.67.10 ..
1.67.d:
आसन्नमभवद्युद्धं सर्वसत्त्वभयङ्करम् ॥
आवयोर्भृगुशार्दूल तदा युद्धे उपस्थिते ॥ 1.67.10 ॥
1.67.m: a battle was imminent, terrifying to all living beings. / When the battle between us was at hand, O tiger of the Bhṛgus,

1.67.s:
ājagāmātha taṃ deśaṃ brahmā śubhacaturmukhaḥ ..
devā brahmarṣayaścaiva tathā rājarṣayo'malāḥ ..1 1 ..
1.67.d:
आजगामाथ तं देशं ब्रह्मा शुभचतुर्मुखः ॥
देवा ब्रह्मर्षयश्चैव तथा राजर्षयोऽमलाः ॥1 1 ॥
1.67.m: Brahmā of the four auspicious faces then came to that region, / as well as the gods, the celestial ṛṣis, and the stainless royal ṛṣis.

1.67.s:
sarveṣāṃ samavetānāmāvayoryuddhasaṃgare ..
uvāca vacanaṃ brahmā sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ .. 12 ..
1.67.d:
सर्वेषां समवेतानामावयोर्युद्धसंगरे ॥
उवाच वचनं ब्रह्मा सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः ॥ 12 ॥
1.67.m: When all were assembled at the encounter of our battle, / Brahmā, reverenced by all the worlds, spoke these words:

1.67.s:
brahmovāca ..
na kartavyaṃ jagannāthau yuddhaṃ paramadāruṇam ..
yuṣmadyuddhena sakalaṃ naśyatīdaṃ jagattrayam .. 13 ..
1.67.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ॥
न कर्तव्यं जगन्नाथौ युद्धं परमदारुणम् ॥
युष्मद्युद्धेन सकलं नश्यतीदं जगत्त्रयम् ॥ 13 ॥
1.67.m: Brahmā said: / You two lords of the world must not fight an exceedingly terrible battle; / by your battle, this entire triple world will perish.

1.67.s:
gṛhītaṃ cāparatnaṃ yatsvayaṃ devena cakriṇā ..
tadāropayatāṃ śūlī śūlicāpaṃ janārdanaḥ .. 14 ..
1.67.d:
गृहीतं चापरत्नं यत्स्वयं देवेन चक्रिणा ॥
तदारोपयतां शूली शूलिचापं जनार्दनः ॥ 14 ॥
1.67.m: Let the trident-bearer string the jewel of a bow which was taken up by the discus-bearing god himself, / and let Janārdana [string] the bow of the trident-bearer.

1.67.s:
jñāsyāmi cāntaraṃ devau cāpāropaṇakarmaṇā ..
śaṅkara uvāca ..
evamukte mama karāddhanurjagrāha keśavaḥ ..
āropituṃ na me śaktiḥ sarvayatnena cābhavat .. 15 ..
1.67.d:
ज्ञास्यामि चान्तरं देवौ चापारोपणकर्मणा ॥
शङ्कर उवाच ॥
एवमुक्ते मम कराद्धनुर्जग्राह केशवः ॥
आरोपितुं न मे शक्तिः सर्वयत्नेन चाभवत् ॥ 15 ॥
1.67.m: I will know the difference between the two gods through the act of stringing the bow. / Śaṅkara said: / When this was said, Keśava took the bow from my hand; / and I had no power to string [his], even with every effort.

1.67.s:
tataśca gatamohena mayā jñāto maheśvaraḥ ..
jñātvā visṛṣṭacāpena stutaśca bhagavāṃstadā .. 16 ..
1.67.d:
ततश्च गतमोहेन मया ज्ञातो महेश्वरः ॥
ज्ञात्वा विसृष्टचापेन स्तुतश्च भगवांस्तदा ॥ 16 ॥
1.67.m: And thereupon, with delusion gone, the Great Lord was recognized by me; / having recognized [him], with the bow cast aside, the Lord was praised [by me] then:

1.67.s:
namo'stu te devavarāprameya namo'stu te sarvaguṇāntarāya ..
namo'stu te devagaṇārcitāya namo'stu te sarvaguṇottarāya .. 17 ..
1.67.d:
नमोऽस्तु ते देववराप्रमेय नमोऽस्तु ते सर्वगुणान्तराय ॥
नमोऽस्तु ते देवगणार्चिताय नमोऽस्तु ते सर्वगुणोत्तराय ॥ 17 ॥
1.67.m: Homage be to you, O unmeasurable foremost of gods! Homage be to you, the inner nature of all qualities! / Homage be to you, worshipped by the hosts of gods! Homage be to you, who transcend all qualities!

1.67.s:
unmeṣamātreṇa tavāprameya dinaṃ samagraṃ prapitāmahasya ..
nimeṣamātreṇa niśā pradiṣṭā yasyāṃ samādāya jagatsa śete .. 18 ..
1.67.d:
उन्मेषमात्रेण तवाप्रमेय दिनं समग्रं प्रपितामहस्य ॥
निमेषमात्रेण निशा प्रदिष्टा यस्यां समादाय जगत्स शेते ॥ 18 ॥
1.67.m: By the mere opening of your eyes, O unmeasurable one, an entire day of the Great Grandfather [occurs]; / by the mere closing of your eyes, night is ordained, in which, withdrawing the world, he sleeps.

1.67.s:
na kāraṇaṃ vedmi taveśa sṛṣṭau saṃhārakāryaṃ ca tathā na vedmi ..
ādyaṃ na madhyaṃ na tathaiva cāntaṃ tvameka īśaḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇaḥ .. 19 ..
1.67.d:
न कारणं वेद्मि तवेश सृष्टौ संहारकार्यं च तथा न वेद्मि ॥
आद्यं न मध्यं न तथैव चान्तं त्वमेक ईशः पुरुषः पुराणः ॥ 19 ॥
1.67.m: I know not the cause of your creation, O Lord, and likewise I know not the work of dissolution; / you have no beginning, no middle, and likewise no end; you alone are the Lord, the ancient Cosmic Person.

1.67.s:
sarveṣu bhūteṣu tathā sthitastvaṃ sarvāṇi bhūtāni tathā taveśa ..
bhūtāntarastho'pi na bhūtasaṃstha āścaryametanmama devadeva .. 1.67.20 ..
1.67.d:
सर्वेषु भूतेषु तथा स्थितस्त्वं सर्वाणि भूतानि तथा तवेश ॥
भूतान्तरस्थोऽपि न भूतसंस्थ आश्चर्यमेतन्मम देवदेव ॥ 1.67.20 ॥
1.67.m: Thus you abide in all beings, and all beings are in you, O Lord; / though dwelling within beings, you are not abiding in beings; this is a wonder to me, O god of gods!

1.67.s:
bhūtāntarasthopi na bhūtanāthaḥ bhūtārjitaiḥ karmabhirāpyase tvam ..
karmāṇi sarvāṇi jagattrayasya dharme sadā yanmahadadbhutaṃ tat .. 21 ..
1.67.d:
भूतान्तरस्थोपि न भूतनाथः भूतार्जितैः कर्मभिराप्यसे त्वम् ॥
कर्माणि सर्वाणि जगत्त्रयस्य धर्मे सदा यन्महदद्भुतं तत् ॥ 21 ॥
1.67.m: Though dwelling within beings, not as a master of beings are you affected by the actions acquired by beings; / that all actions of the three worlds are always in dharma, that is a great wonder.

1.67.s:
gandhaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca raso'psu deva vāyau yathā sparśaguṇastvadīyaḥ ..
rūpaṃ tathāgnau gagane ca śabdo guṇā samagrāstava bhūtasaṃghe .. 22 ..
1.67.d:
गन्धः पृथिव्यां च रसोऽप्सु देव वायौ यथा स्पर्शगुणस्त्वदीयः ॥
रूपं तथाग्नौ गगने च शब्दो गुणा समग्रास्तव भूतसंघे ॥ 22 ॥
1.67.m: Fragrance is in the earth, and taste in the waters, O god; as the quality of touch in the wind is yours, / likewise form in fire, and sound in space: all qualities in the assembly of beings are yours.

1.67.s:
manogatastvaṃ ca tathā vitarko buddhau gatastvaṃ ca viniścayo'tra ..
cidrūpamātmanyatha devadeva avyaktasaṃsthasya guṇatrayastvam .. 23 ..
1.67.d:
मनोगतस्त्वं च तथा वितर्को बुद्धौ गतस्त्वं च विनिश्चयोऽत्र ॥
चिद्रूपमात्मन्यथ देवदेव अव्यक्तसंस्थस्य गुणत्रयस्त्वम् ॥ 23 ॥
1.67.m:
And you are thought present in the mind, and you are ascertainment present in the intellect here;
you are the nature of consciousness in the self, O God of gods, and you are the triad of gunas residing in the unmanifest.

1.67.s:
tvameva bhūtāni ca tadguṇāśca mūrtervibhinnosi na bhūtabhinnaḥ ..
tattvāni sarvāṇi ca tadvyatītaḥ tvameva devaḥ puruṣaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ .. 24 ..
1.67.d:
त्वमेव भूतानि च तद्गुणाश्च मूर्तेर्विभिन्नोसि न भूतभिन्नः ॥
तत्त्वानि सर्वाणि च तद्व्यतीतः त्वमेव देवः पुरुषः प्रदिष्टः ॥ 24 ॥
1.67.m:
You alone are the elements and their qualities; you are distinct from form, yet not separate from the elements;
you are all the principles and beyond them; you alone are proclaimed the divine Cosmic Person.

1.67.s:
tavecchayā syātsakalā trilokī tavecchayā deva tathā vinaśyet ..
itthaṃvidhasyānagha karmaṇaste stutiḥ kathaṃ syātparamasya dhāmnaḥ .. 25 ..
1.67.d:
तवेच्छया स्यात्सकला त्रिलोकी तवेच्छया देव तथा विनश्येत् ॥
इत्थंविधस्यानघ कर्मणस्ते स्तुतिः कथं स्यात्परमस्य धाम्नः ॥ 25 ॥
1.67.m:
By your will the entire threefold world comes to be; by your will, O God, it likewise perishes.
How could there be praise for the deed of such a one as you, O sinless one, who are the supreme abode?

1.67.s:
evaṃ stuto devavaro mayāsāvuvāca māṃ devagaṇasya madhye ..
yo'haṃ sa devaḥ parameśvarastvaṃ yo'haṃ sa devaḥ prapitāmahaśca .. 26 ..
1.67.d:
एवं स्तुतो देववरो मयासावुवाच मां देवगणस्य मध्ये ॥
योऽहं स देवः परमेश्वरस्त्वं योऽहं स देवः प्रपितामहश्च ॥ 26 ॥
1.67.m:
Praised in this way by me, that best of gods spoke to me in the midst of the host of gods:
“He who is I is the god that is you, the supreme lord; he who is I is the god that is the great-grandfather [Brahmā].

1.67.s:
āśritya mūrtitritayaṃ mayedaṃ karmatrayaṃ śaṅkara sādhyate vai ..
utpattināśau paripālanaṃ ca kālatraye śaṅkara devakāryāt .. 27 ..
1.67.d:
आश्रित्य मूर्तित्रितयं मयेदं कर्मत्रयं शङ्कर साध्यते वै ॥
उत्पत्तिनाशौ परिपालनं च कालत्रये शङ्कर देवकार्यात् ॥ 27 ॥
1.67.m:
Resorting to this triad of forms, O Śaṅkara, this threefold task is indeed accomplished by me:
creation, destruction, and preservation, across the three times, O Śaṅkara, for the sake of the work of the gods.

1.67.s:
mūrtirmamogrā jagatāṃ taveyaṃ saṃhārakāryārthamudīrṇadarpā ..
tprabhurbhavaḥ kāraṇakāraṇānāṃ pūjyaśca sarveśvara sarvadevaiḥ .. 28 ..
1.67.d:
मूर्तिर्ममोग्रा जगतां तवेयं संहारकार्यार्थमुदीर्णदर्पा ॥
त्प्रभुर्भवः कारणकारणानां पूज्यश्च सर्वेश्वर सर्वदेवैः ॥ 28 ॥
1.67.m:
This fierce form of mine, of elevated pride, is yours for the work of cosmic dissolution for the worlds;
you are Bhava, the lord of the causes of causes, and, O lord of all, worshipful by all gods.

1.67.s:
ye tvāṃ namasyanti jagatpradhānaṃ bhaktiṃ parā ye ca vahanti tubhyam ..
bhaktyā ca nityaṃ tava pūjayanti sthānaṃ hi teṣāṃ sulabhaṃ madīyam .. 29 ..
1.67.d:
ये त्वां नमस्यन्ति जगत्प्रधानं भक्तिं परा ये च वहन्ति तुभ्यम् ॥
भक्त्या च नित्यं तव पूजयन्ति स्थानं हि तेषां सुलभं मदीयम् ॥ 29 ॥
1.67.m:
Those who bow to you, the foremost of the universe, and who bear supreme devotion to you,
and who constantly worship you with devotion—to them my abode is easily attained.

1.67.s:
madīyametadbhuvi cāparatvaṃ pradīyatāṃ bhārgavanandanāya ..
ṛcīkaputrāya guṇādhikāya tasmātsamādāsyati tasya putraḥ .. 1.67.30 ..
1.67.d:
मदीयमेतद्भुवि चापरत्वं प्रदीयतां भार्गवनन्दनाय ॥
ऋचीकपुत्राय गुणाधिकाय तस्मात्समादास्यति तस्य पुत्रः ॥ 1.67.30 ॥
1.67.m:
Let this jewel of a bow of mine on earth be given to the descendant of Bhṛgu,
to the son of Ṛcīka, superior in virtues; from him his son will receive it.

1.67.s:
sa tena cāpena nihatya śatrūnkṛtvā ca laghvīṃ vasudhāṃ sureśa ..
taccāparatnaṃ bhuvi rāghavāya pradāsyate rāma iti śrutāya ..31..
1.67.d:
स तेन चापेन निहत्य शत्रून्कृत्वा च लघ्वीं वसुधां सुरेश ॥
तच्चापरत्नं भुवि राघवाय प्रदास्यते राम इति श्रुताय ॥31॥
1.67.m:
Having slain his enemies with that bow and made the earth light, O lord of gods,
he will give that jewel of a bow on earth to the descendant of Raghu, renowned as Rāma.

1.67.s:
kṛtvā sa rāmopi hi tena karma pradāsyate tadvaruṇāya cāpam ..
tasmātsamādāsyati phālguno'pi devārthakāryaikaratirmahātmā .. 32 ..
1.67.d:
कृत्वा स रामोपि हि तेन कर्म प्रदास्यते तद्वरुणाय चापम् ॥
तस्मात्समादास्यति फाल्गुनोऽपि देवार्थकार्यैकरतिर्महात्मा ॥ 32 ॥
1.67.m:
Having also performed his task with it, that Rāma will give that bow to Varuṇa;
from him the great-souled Phālguna too, devoted solely to the tasks of the gods, will receive it.

1.67.s:
svaṃ cāparatnaṃ janakāya dehi nimītināmnā bhuvi śabditāya ..
tenāpi cāpena sa tatprasūto rājā mahatkarma kariṣyatīti ..33..
1.67.d:
स्वं चापरत्नं जनकाय देहि निमीतिनाम्ना भुवि शब्दिताय ॥
तेनापि चापेन स तत्प्रसूतो राजा महत्कर्म करिष्यतीति ॥33॥
1.67.m:
Give your own jewel of a bow to Janaka, renowned on earth by the name Nimi;
with that bow too, the king born of him will accomplish a great deed.”

1.67.s:
...duktvā bhagavānmahātmā jagāma kāṣṭhāṃ manasastvabhīṣṭām ..
mayā tathā te bhuvi cāparatne dvijapradhāna kṣitipeṣu datte .. 34 ..
1.67.d:
॥।दुक्त्वा भगवान्महात्मा जगाम काष्ठां मनसस्त्वभीष्टाम् ॥
मया तथा ते भुवि चापरत्ने द्विजप्रधान क्षितिपेषु दत्ते ॥ 34 ॥
1.67.m:
Having spoken [thus], the great-souled Blessed One went to the region desired by his mind.
In that way, O foremost of the twice-born, those two jewels among bows were given by me to the kings of the earth.

1.67.s:
yadvaipṇavaṃ cāpavaraṃ pituste nyastaṃ kare vāsukitulyarūpam ..
taddevakāryeṇa vinā na śakyaṃ kenāpyadhijya yudhi rāma kartum .. 35 ..
1.67.d:
यद्वैप्णवं चापवरं पितुस्ते न्यस्तं करे वासुकितुल्यरूपम् ॥
तद्देवकार्येण विना न शक्यं केनाप्यधिज्य युधि राम कर्तुम् ॥ 35 ॥
1.67.m:
That excellent bow of Viṣṇu, similar in form to Vāsuki, which was placed in your father’s hand—
without the work of the gods, O Rāma, it could not be strung by anyone in battle.

1.67.s:
ajñātavasturacitaṃ surakāryadakṣaṃ govindabāhuviṭapāśrayalabdhamānam ..
nyastaṃ purā pitṛkare tava yuddhaśauṇḍa cetthaṃ mayā harivacaḥ prasamīkṣya rāma ..36..
1.67.d:
अज्ञातवस्तुरचितं सुरकार्यदक्षं गोविन्दबाहुविटपाश्रयलब्धमानम् ॥
न्यस्तं पुरा पितृकरे तव युद्धशौण्ड चेत्थं मया हरिवचः प्रसमीक्ष्य राम ॥36॥
1.67.m:
Fashioned from unknown substance, capable of the work of the gods, having attained its measure by resting on the branch-like arms of Govinda,
it was formerly placed in your father’s hand by me, O hero of battle, having thus reflected upon the word of Hari, O Rāma.

1.68.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
evamuktastadā rāmo devadevena śambhunā ..
praṇamya śirasā devaṃ pārvatīṃ varadāṃ tathā .. 1 ..
1.68.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥ ॥
एवमुक्तस्तदा रामो देवदेवेन शम्भुना ॥
प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं पार्वतीं वरदां तथा ॥ 1 ॥
1.68.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Having been spoken to in this way by the God of gods, Śambhu,
Rāma bowed his head to the god and to Pārvatī, the granter of boons,

and embraced by the Pramathas with longing in his inner self,
that crusher of hostile armies departed toward the hermitage of his father.

1.68.s:
so'cireṇaiva saṃprāpya dadarśāśramamaṇḍale ..
vayovṛddhaṃ tapovṛddhaṃ pitaraṃ dīptatejasam .. 3 ..
1.68.d:
सोऽचिरेणैव संप्राप्य ददर्शाश्रममण्डले ॥
वयोवृद्धं तपोवृद्धं पितरं दीप्ततेजसम् ॥ 3 ॥
1.68.m:
Arriving before long, he saw in the hermitage circle
his father, advanced in age, advanced in asceticism, and radiant with splendour.

1.68.s:
so'bhivādya pituḥ pādau mātuśca paravīrahā ..
bhrātṝṇāmānupūrvyeṇa dharmanityo jitendriyaḥ .. ..4 ..
1.68.d:
सोऽभिवाद्य पितुः पादौ मातुश्च परवीरहा ॥
भ्रातॄणामानुपूर्व्येण धर्मनित्यो जितेन्द्रियः ॥ ॥4 ॥
1.68.m:
That slayer of enemy heroes, ever devoted to dharma, whose senses were subdued,
greeted the feet of his father and mother, and of his brothers in proper order.

1.68.s:
taiśca mūrdhanyupāghrātaḥ sāntvitassa mahātapāḥ ..
sa matprasādaṃ pṛṣṭaścetyuktvā sarvamaśeṣataḥ ..5..
1.68.d:
तैश्च मूर्धन्युपाघ्रातः सान्त्वितस्स महातपाः ॥
स मत्प्रसादं पृष्टश्चेत्युक्त्वा सर्वमशेषतः ॥5॥
1.68.m:
Smelled on the head by them and consoled, that great ascetic,
being asked about my favour, related everything without remainder.

1.68.s:
ākhyātavām̐stataḥ paścātpātālagamanaṃ tadā ..
āsannaṃ devakāryaṃ ca cāparatnaṃ ca vaiṣṇavam .. 6 ..
1.68.d:
आख्यातवाम्̐स्ततः पश्चात्पातालगमनं तदा ॥
आसन्नं देवकार्यं च चापरत्नं च वैष्णवम् ॥ 6 ॥
1.68.m:
Then afterward he reported the going to Pātāla at that time,
and the imminent work of the gods, and the jewel of a bow belonging to Viṣṇu.

1.68.s:
jamadagnirmahātejāḥ śrutvā rāmavacastadā ..
cāparatnaṃ ca rāmāya pradadau devapūjitam .. 7 ..
1.68.d:
जमदग्निर्महातेजाः श्रुत्वा रामवचस्तदा ॥
चापरत्नं च रामाय प्रददौ देवपूजितम् ॥ 7 ॥
1.68.m:
Hearing the words of Rāma at that time, Jamadagni of great splendour
gave to Rāma the jewel of a bow worshipped by the gods.

1.68.s:
dattvovāca sa taṃ rāmaṃ hutāśanasamaprabham ..
paścimena samudreṇa praviśya varuṇālayam..9 ..
1.68.d:
